```{r}

theme_marie_clean <- function(bg = "#E5EBF0") {   # <-- adjustable background color
  theme(
    # --- TEXT ---
    text = element_text(color = "black"),     # <- ALL text black
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1, vjust=1),

    # --- PANEL BACKGROUND ---
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = bg,    # <- background color variable
      color = NA
    ),
    panel.border = element_blank(),

    # --- GRID ---
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      color = "grey50",
      linetype = "solid",
      linewidth = 0.1
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    # --- AXES ---
    axis.line = element_line(color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.5),

    # --- FACET STRIPS ---
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = NA
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 15,
      color = "black"
    ),

    # --- LEGEND ---
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = alpha("white", 0),  # <- transparent
      color = NA                 # <- no border
    ),
    legend.key = element_rect(
      fill = alpha("white", 0),  # <- transparent key
      color = NA
    ),

    # --- MARGINS ---
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  )
}
```

## Figure S9: Quality of reads

```{r}

# ================================
# 1. Directory with Q-bin TSV files
# ================================
indir <- paste0(WD, "/results/read_quality")

files <- list.files(indir, pattern = "_Qbins.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# ================================
# 2. Function to extract metadata from filenames
#    Format: method_primer_sample_reads_Qbins.tsv
# ================================
parse_qbin_file <- function(path) {
  fname <- basename(path) |> gsub("_Qbins.tsv", "", x = _)
  parts <- strsplit(fname, "_")[[1]]

  tibble(
    method = parts[1],
    primer = parts[2],
    sample = parts[3],
    reads  = parts[4],
    file   = path
  )
}

metadata <- map_dfr(files, parse_qbin_file)
seq_method_colors <- c("Pacbio" = "#CC007A", "ONT" = "#0077B6")

# ================================
# 3. Load Q-bin tables and merge with metadata
# ================================
df <- metadata %>%
  mutate(data = map(file, ~ read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
  unnest(data)

# Ensure correct factor order (optional)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(adjust_cout = ifelse(primer == "V4", count, count/10)) %>% 
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = c("pacbio", "super"),
                    labels = c("PacBio", "ONT")),
    primer = factor(primer, levels = c("V4", "V1V3", "V1V8", "OPR"), 
                    labels = c("V4", "V1-V3", "V1-V8", "OPR")),
    sample = factor(sample, levels = c("Zmock", "Zfecal", "AD", "WWTP", "Soil"))
  ) 



# ================================
# 4. Compute median Q-bins (weighted by read count)
# ================================


# Function for weighted median (base R does not have one)
weightedMedian <- function(x, w) {
  w <- w / sum(w)
  idx <- order(x)
  x <- x[idx]
  w <- w[idx]
  cw <- cumsum(w)
  x[which(cw >= 0.5)[1]]
}

median_df <- df %>%
  group_by(method, primer, sample) %>%
  summarise(
    medianQ = weightedMedian(Q_bin, w = count),
    .groups = "drop"
  )



# ================================
# 4. Plot Q-score distributions
# ================================
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Q_bin, y = adjust_cout, color = method, fill = method)) +
  geom_area(position = "identity", alpha = 0.35) +
  # Add median lines
  geom_vline(data = median_df,
             aes(xintercept = medianQ, color = method),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8, show.legend = F) +
    # Add median lines
  geom_text(data = median_df,
             aes(x = medianQ + 3, color = method, label = medianQ, y = 2000), show.legend = F
             ) +
  facet_grid(sample ~ primer, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("PacBio" = "#CC007A",
                                "ONT"    =  "#0077B6")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("PacBio" = "#CC007A",
                               "ONT"    =  "#0077B6")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distributions of Mean Read Q-Scores",
    x = "Mean Q-score",
    y = "Read count",
    color = "Sequencing method",
    fill = "Sequencing method"
  ) +
  theme_marie_clean() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5), 
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p)


plot_name="Fig_S9_Read_quality"
plot_folder=folder_dir_supp
ggsave(paste0(plot_dir,"/" ,plot_folder, "/", plot_name, ".png"), width = 14, height = 8)
ggsave(paste0(plot_dir,"/" ,plot_folder, "/", plot_name, ".svg"), width = 14, height = 8)


rm(p, median_df, df, weightedMedian, metadata, parse_qbin_file, indir, files)

```


# Load reference amplicons

- Load theoretical abundance
- Load summery of reference sequences including distinct amplicon variants 

```{r}

load_reference_amplicons <- function(ref_dir = paste0(WD, "/data/Zmock_in_silico_amplicons")) {
  # List all fasta/fa files
  fasta_files <- list.files(ref_dir, pattern = "\\.(fa|fasta)$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  # Helper to read one file
  read_fasta_headers <- function(file_path) {
    # Extract primerset from file name (e.g. "V4_bacterial_amplicons.fasta" → "V4")
    primerset <- stringr::str_extract(basename(file_path), "^[A-Za-z0-9]+")
    
    # Read only header lines
    headers <- readLines(file_path)
    headers <- headers[stringr::str_detect(headers, "^>")]
    
    # Extract species and copy number
    tibble::tibble(
      primerset = primerset,
      header = stringr::str_remove(headers, "^>"),
      species = stringr::str_extract(as.character(header), "^[^_;]+"),
                                     #"^[A-Za-z_]+_[A-Za-z_]+"
      copynumber = as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(header, "(?<=size=)\\d+"))
    )
  }
  
  # Apply to all files and combine
  all_refs <- purrr::map_dfr(fasta_files, read_fasta_headers)
  return(all_refs)
}
  
ref_amplicons <- load_reference_amplicons() %>% 
  group_by(primerset) %>% 
  #dplyr::rename("header" = "Reference_ID") %>% 
  dplyr::rename("Reference_ID" = "header") %>% 
  mutate(total_correct_ASVs = n()) %>% 
  mutate(
    Reference_ID_old = Reference_ID,
    Reference_ID = str_remove(Reference_ID,"_16S"),
         Reference_ID = str_remove(Reference_ID,"_RC"), 
         Reference_ID = str_remove(Reference_ID,"_chromosome"),
         species = str_remove(species,"_RC"), 
         species = str_remove(species,"_chromosome"),
         species = str_replace_all(species,"_", " " ),
         species = str_trim(species) 
         ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  #group_by(primerset, species) %>% 
  mutate(n_merged = str_count(Reference_ID, "_"), 
         copynumber = copynumber + n_merged -1,
         copynumber = if_else((str_detect(Reference_ID, "Salmonella_5") & primerset != "OPR"), copynumber+1, copynumber),   # manually checked - due to megered of Salmonella_2_4 inside Salmonella_5
         clean_ID = str_replace(Reference_ID, "^([^_]+_[0-9]+).*", "\\1"),
        Reference_ID = paste0(clean_ID, ";size=", copynumber)
         ) %>% 
  group_by(species, primerset) %>% 
  mutate(
    rRNA_Copy_No = sum(copynumber),
    primerset = factor(primerset, levels = c("V4", "V1V3", "V1V8", "OPR")), 
    ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-clean_ID, -n_merged)

rm(load_reference_amplicons)
```

```{r}
        "tax_level" = "Order",
        "tax_abun" = "rel_abun_order"
      )
  } else if (tax_level == "Class") {
    
    df_tax_level <- {{data}} %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      mutate(samples = map(.x = samples, ~group_by(.x, Class) %>% mutate(rel_abun_class = sum(rel_abun_ASV)) %>% ungroup())) %>% 
      mutate(samples = 
               map(.x = samples, ~
                     ungroup(.) %>% 
                     distinct(Class, rel_abun_class) %>% 
                     filter(!str_detect(Class, "unclassified")) %>% 
                     mutate(over_limit = if_else(rel_abun_class >= abun_limit, T, F))
               )) %>% 
      unnest(samples) %>% 
      rename(
        "tax_level" = "Class",
        "tax_abun" = "rel_abun_class"
      )
  } else if (tax_level == "Phylum") {
    
    df_tax_level <- {{data}} %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      mutate(samples = map(.x = samples, ~group_by(.x, Phylum) %>% mutate(rel_abun_phylum = sum(rel_abun_ASV)) %>% ungroup())) %>% 
      mutate(samples = 
               map(.x = samples, ~
                     ungroup(.) %>% 
                     distinct(Phylum, rel_abun_phylum) %>% 
                     filter(!str_detect(Phylum, "unclassified")) %>% 
                     mutate(over_limit = if_else(rel_abun_phylum >= abun_limit, T, F))
               )) %>% 
      unnest(samples) %>% 
      dplyr::rename(
        "tax_level" = "Phylum",
        "tax_abun" = "rel_abun_phylum"
      )
  } else {
    print("Check spelling of tax_level ")
  }
  
  ## Filter low abundant Species
  tax_over_limit <- 
    df_tax_level %>% 
    group_by(tax_level) %>% 
    reframe(sum = sum(over_limit)) %>% 
    filter(sum > 0) %>% 
    distinct(tax_level) %>% unlist()
  
  df_tax_level_filtered <- 
    df_tax_level %>% 
    filter(tax_level %in% tax_over_limit)
  
  ## Calculate distance matrix 
  abun_matrix <- df_tax_level_filtered %>% 
    distinct(SampleID, tax_level, tax_abun) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = tax_level, values_from = tax_abun, values_fill = 0) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("SampleID") %>% 
    as.matrix()
  
  bray_curtis_dist <- vegan::vegdist((abun_matrix), method = "bray")
  
  print(bray_curtis_dist)
  # 
  # bc.dist.matrix <- 
  #   vegan::vegdist(t(ampvis_object_fil$abund), method = distance_matrix)
  # 
  
  adonis_of_differnet_varibles <- function(varibles_character){
    
    # Build metadata with a generic column name: test_var
  metadata <- data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(test_var = .data[[varibles_character]]) %>%  # <- key line
    dplyr::distinct(SampleID, test_var)
    
  print(metadata)
    # metadata <- 
    #   data %>% 
    #   rename(varibles_character = "test_var") %>% 
    #   select(SampleID, test_var)
    
    var <- if_else(is.numeric(metadata$test_var),
                   paste0("in the range: ", min(as.numeric(unique(metadata$test_var)), na.rm = T), "-", 
                          max(as.numeric(metadata$test_var))),
                   paste0(unique(as.character(metadata$test_var)),collapse = ", "))
    
    x <- vegan::adonis2(bray_curtis_dist ~ test_var, data = metadata)
    
    #a = cat("Test of **" varibles_character,"** R^2=", round(x$R2[1],2), ", p<", x$`Pr(>F)`[1])
    b <- (paste0("<br>",tax_level," ADONIS analysis for **", varibles_character, "**. <br>", 
                 "**R^2^=", round(x$R2[1],2), ", p<", x$`Pr(>F)`[1], "**. <br> ", 
                 "The varibles tested are: *", 
                 var, "*.<br>"))
    
    d <- tibble(
      test = varibles_character, 
      result = b
    )
    d
  }
  
  list <- lapply(test_varibles, 
                 FUN = adonis_of_differnet_varibles)
  
  do.call(rbind, list)
  
}
```

```{r}

### Load results from all disinct runs (not in git)


load_subsample_structure <- function(
  folders,
  base_dir = "/home/bio.aau.dk/hd95lp/Projects/RETHINK/p_nanopore_amplicon/6_snakemake_usearch_run_all"
) {
  
  # ---- Helper: parse dataset folder name ----
  parse_folder <- function(folder_name) {
    parts <- str_split(folder_name, "_")[[1]]
    
    tibble(
      dataset        = folder_name,
      basecalling    = parts[1],
      primerset      = parts[3],
      sample_content = parts[4]
    )
  }
  
  # ---- Helper: extract barcodes + total reads from log ----
  extract_log_info <- function(logfile) {
    if (!file.exists(logfile)) {
      return(
        tibble(
          barcodes = NA_character_,
          total_reads = NA_real_
        )
      )
    }
    
    log_txt <- readLines(logfile)
    
    # Extract barcodes
    bc <- log_txt %>%
      str_subset("cat tmp/02-trim_primers") %>%
      str_extract_all("barcode[0-9]+") %>%
      unlist() %>%
      unique() %>%
      paste(collapse = ",")
    
    # Extract total merged reads
    n_reads <- log_txt %>%
      str_subset("Total merged reads") %>%
      str_extract("[0-9]+") %>%
      as.numeric()
    
    tibble(
      barcodes = ifelse(length(bc) == 0, NA_character_, bc),
      total_reads = n_reads
    )
  }
  
  #dataset <- folders[1]
  # ---- MAIN PROCESSING: per dataset ----
  process_one_dataset <- function(dataset) {
    
    # parse metadata
    meta <- parse_folder(dataset)
    
    # paths
    #subsample_dir <- file.path(base_dir, dataset, "output", "03-subsample")
    subsample_dir <- file.path(base_dir, dataset, "output", "04-denoise")
    log_file <- file.path(base_dir, dataset, "logs", "03-subsample", "concat_all_trimmed.log")
    
    # subsample folders
    available <- list.files(subsample_dir, pattern = "^sample_size_", full.names = FALSE)
    
    # log info
    log_info <- extract_log_info(log_file) %>% distinct()
    
    # Build tibble for each subsample
    tibble(subsampling_group = available) %>%
      mutate(
        dataset        = dataset,
        basecalling    = meta$basecalling,
        primerset      = meta$primerset,
        sample_content = meta$sample_content,
        
        # NEW: barcodes used for all rows
        barcodes = log_info$barcodes,
        
        # reads_used
        reads_used = case_when(
          subsampling_group == "sample_size_all_reads" ~ log_info$total_reads,
          TRUE ~ str_extract(subsampling_group, "[0-9]+") %>% as.numeric()
        )
      )
  }
  
  # ---- Apply to all datasets ----
  map_df(folders, process_one_dataset)
}

)
```

```{r}
plot_one_primer <- function(primer_name) {
  
  bw <- binwidths[[primer_name]]   # pick binwidth for this primer
  
  plot_df %>%
        filter(primerset == primer_name) %>%
        left_join(plot_df_refs_df) %>% 
     mutate(
      basecalling = factor(basecalling, levels = c("pacbio", "super"),
                    labels = c("PacBio", "ONT")),
    primerset = factor(primerset, levels = c("V4", "V1V3", "V1V8", "OPR"), 
                    labels = c("V4 (bin: 8)", "V1-V3 (bin: 15)", "V1-V8 (bin: 35)", "OPR (bin: 100)")),
    sample_content = factor(sample_content, levels = c("Zmock", "Zfecal", "AD", "WWTP", "Soil"))
  ) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = length, fill = basecalling)) +
    geom_histogram(
      binwidth = bw,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.3,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    facet_nested(sample_content ~ primerset, scales = "free"#, space = "free"
               ) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = limit_min), color = "red", linetype = 2) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = limit_max), color = "red", linetype = 2) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median), color = "black", linetype = 2, linewidth = 1.3) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = seq_method_colors) +
    labs(
      title = primer_name,
      x = "Sequence length (bp)",
      y = "ASV count",
    ) +
    theme_marie_clean() + 
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Sequencing platform")) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), 
          #legend.title = element_blank()
          )
}
```

```{r}
base_dir <- "/home/bio.aau.dk/hd95lp/Projects/RETHINK/ont-asv-microbial-profiling/postprocessing/results/uchime_ref"

# Identify primer folders automatically

# Function to load one uchime table
load_uchime_table <- function(primer) {
  txt_path <- file.path(base_dir, primer, "asvs_uchime_ref.txt")

  if (!file.exists(txt_path)) {
    warning("No uchime table found for primer: ", primer)
    return(NULL)
  }

  read_tsv(
    txt_path,
    col_names = FALSE,
    comment = "#",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      primerset = primer,
      # Column 1 contains sequence ID → trim anything after semicolon
      global_asv_id = sub(";.*", "", X1)
    )
}

# Load all .txt files
```

```{r}
###############################################################
# 1. Define linear-phase filter per primer
###############################################################

get_linear_filter <- function(df) {
  prim <- unique(df$primerset)
  if (length(prim) != 1) stop("get_linear_filter() expects a single primerset.")

  max_true <- max(df$n_ASV)

  if (prim == "V4") {
    df %>% filter(n_ASV >= 1 & n_ASV < max_true)

  } else if (prim %in% c("V1-V3", "V1-V8", "OPR")) {
    df %>% filter(n_ASV >= 2 & n_ASV < 0.9 * max_true)

  } else df
}


###############################################################
# 2. Fit linear-phase model
###############################################################

fit_linear_phase <- function(df) {
  df_lin <- get_linear_filter(df)

  if (nrow(df_lin) < 2) return(NULL)

  mod <- lm(n_ASV ~ log10(reads_used), data = df_lin)

  pred_df <- tibble(
    reads_used = seq(min(df_lin$reads_used),
                     max(df_lin$reads_used), length.out = 200),
    basecalling = unique(df$basecalling)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      log_reads  = log10(reads_used),
      pred_nASV  = predict(mod, newdata = .)
    )

  list(
    df_linear = df_lin,
    model     = mod,
    pred      = pred_df
  )
}


###############################################################
# 3. Compute #reads needed for ASV = 1
###############################################################

compute_reads_for_asv1 <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  slope <- coef(fit$model)[2]
  intercept <- coef(fit$model)[1]

  if (slope <= 0) return(NA_real_)

  reads <- 10^((5 - intercept) / slope)
  reads
}


###############################################################
# 4. Extract slope, R², and mean reads-per-ASV
###############################################################

extract_metrics <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit) || is.null(fit$model)) return(NULL)

  df_lin <- fit$df_linear
  slope  <- coef(fit$model)[2]
  intercept <- coef(fit$model)[1]
  r2 <- summary(fit$model)$r.squared
  rpASV <- df_lin$reads_used / df_lin$n_ASV

  tibble(
    slope = slope,
    intercept = intercept,
    r2 = r2,
    mean_reads_per_ASV = mean(rpASV),
    median_reads_per_ASV = median(rpASV)
  )
}


###############################################################
# 5. MAIN PLOT FUNCTION: PacBio + ONT with annotations
###############################################################

plot_paired_linear <- function(df, primerset = "V4") {

  dat <- df %>% filter(primerset == {{primerset}})
  max_true <- max(dat$total_correct_ASVs)

  pb  <- dat %>% filter(basecalling == "Pacbio") %>% fit_linear_phase()
  ont <- dat %>% filter(basecalling == "ONT")    %>% fit_linear_phase()

  # Extract metrics
  pb_metrics  <- extract_metrics(pb)
  ont_metrics <- extract_metrics(ont)

  # Reads required for ASV = 1
  pb_reads1  <- compute_reads_for_asv1(pb)
  ont_reads1 <- compute_reads_for_asv1(ont)

  # Fold-difference ONT / PacBio
  fold_diff <- NA_real_
  if (!is.na(pb_reads1) && !is.na(ont_reads1)) {
    fold_diff <- ont_reads1 / pb_reads1
  }

  ###########################################################
  # Create main plot
  ###########################################################

  #c("#CC007A", "#0077B6")
  
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = reads_used, y = n_ASV, color = basecalling)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.8, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = max_true, linetype = "dotted") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Pacbio"="#CC007A","ONT"="#0077B6")) +
    labs(
      title =paste0(primerset, ": Max ASVs = ", max_true),
      x = "Reads (log10 scale)",
      y = "Number of ASVs"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face="bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Sequencing platform")) 

  ###########################################################
  # Add PacBio fit + annotations
  ###########################################################
  if (!is.null(pb)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_line(data = pb$pred,
                aes(x = reads_used, y = pred_nASV),
                color = "#CC007A", linewidth = 1.2) +
      geom_point(data = pb$df_linear,
                 aes(x = reads_used, y = n_ASV),
                 color = "#CC007A", size = 3, shape = 21)

    if (!is.na(pb_reads1)) {
      p <- p +
        annotate("text",
                 x = 100,#pb_reads1, 
                 y =max_true*0.95, hjust = 0,
                   fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.8),   # background with transparency
                 label = paste0("PB: ~", format(round(pb_reads1), big.mark=","), 
                                " reads (ASV=5)\nSlope=", signif(pb_metrics$slope,3),
                                ", R²=", signif(pb_metrics$r2,3)),
                 hjust = -0.1, color = "#CC007A", size = 3.1)
    }
  }

  ###########################################################
  # Add ONT fit + annotations
  ###########################################################
  if (!is.null(ont)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_line(data = ont$pred,
                aes(x = reads_used, y = pred_nASV),
                color = "#0077B6", linewidth = 1.2) +
      geom_point(data = ont$df_linear,
                 aes(x = reads_used, y = n_ASV),
                 color = "#0077B6", size = 3, shape = 21)

    if (!is.na(ont_reads1)) {
      p <- p +
        annotate("text",
                 x = 100,#ont_reads1, 
                 y = max_true*0.86, hjust = 0,
                 label = paste0("ONT: ~", format(round(ont_reads1), big.mark=","), 
                                " reads (ASV=5)\nSlope=", signif(ont_metrics$slope,3),
                                ", R²=", signif(ont_metrics$r2,3)),
                 hjust = -0.1, color = "#0077B6", size = 3.1)
    }
  }

  ###########################################################
  # Fold difference annotation
  ###########################################################
  if (!is.na(fold_diff)) {
    p <- p +
      annotate("text",
               x = 100, #min(dat$reads_used)*6,
               y = max_true*1.05,
               hjust = 0,
               label = paste0("ONT requires ~", signif(fold_diff,3),
                              "× more reads (ASV = 5)"),
               color = "black", size = 4)
  }

  p + theme_marie_clean() + 
    theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0)) + 
    facet_grid(~primerset )
}


###############################################################
# 6. Generate final patchwork
###############################################################

primer_levels <- c("V4", "V1-V3", "V1-V8", "OPR")


plots <- lapply(primer_levels, \(p) plot_paired_linear(df, p))



wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 4, axes = "collect", guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r, load amp object}
#------------------------------------------------------------
# Function 2: Read ASV tables into ampvis 
#------------------------------------------------------------
read_and_format_to_amp_object <- function(
  base_dir,
  base_dir2, #= "/home/bio.aau.dk/hd95lp/Projects/RETHINK/p_nanopore_amplicon/6_snakemake_usearch_run_all",
  primerset_name = "V1V3",
  subsample_group = "all_reads",
  global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match,
  new_barcode,
  type = "_exact"   # all
  ) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(tidyr)

  # Helper to read ASV tables
  read_asv_table <- function(file, method) {
    first <- readLines(file, n = 1)
    if (startsWith(first, "#")) {
      header <- strsplit(sub("^#", "", first), "\t")[[1]]
      df <- read_tsv(file, col_names = header, skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)
    } else {
      df <- read_tsv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    }
    names(df)[1] <- "OTU"
    #names(df)[-1] <- paste0(method, "_", names(df)[-1])
    df
  }

  # Subset glabal ASVs to the actual runs (rather than all)
  generated_ASV_all_runs_super <- global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>%
    #filter(basecalling == "super") %>% 
    filter(sample_content == "Zmock", primerset == primerset_name) %>% #print(n = 19) %>% 
    distinct(basecalling, global_asv_id )
  
  generated_ASV_all_runs_pacbio <- global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>%
    #filter(basecalling == "pacbio") %>% 
    filter(sample_content == "Zmock", primerset == primerset_name) %>% 
    distinct(basecalling, global_asv_id)  
  
  
  ### -----------------------------  
  ### CASE 1: EXACT MATCH TABLES  
  ### -----------------------------
  if (type == "_exact") {

    file_super  <- file.path(base_dir, primerset_name, "super_ASVtab.txt")
    file_pacbio <- file.path(base_dir, primerset_name, "pacbio_ASVtab.txt")
    print("hi")

    df_super <- read_asv_table(file_super, "super") %>%
      mutate(
        ref_name = str_extract(OTU, "(?<=ref_)[^;]+"),
        global_asv_id = str_extract(OTU, "(?<=asv_)[^;]+"),
        basecalling = "super",
      ) %>%
      filter(global_asv_id %in% unlist(generated_ASV_all_runs_super$global_asv_id))

    df_pacbio <- read_asv_table(file_pacbio, "pacbio") %>%
      mutate(
        ref_name = str_extract(OTU, "(?<=ref_)[^;]+"),
        global_asv_id = str_extract(OTU, "(?<=asv_)[^;]+"), 
        basecalling = "pacbio",
      ) %>%
      filter(global_asv_id %in% unlist(generated_ASV_all_runs_pacbio$global_asv_id))
    
    # Combine super + pacbio
  df_combined <- full_join(df_super, df_pacbio) %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with(c("barcode")), ~ replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    filter(global_asv_id %in% unlist(global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>% distinct(global_asv_id)) | !is.na(ref_name)) %>%
    select(-OTU) 
  }
  
  
   ### -----------------------------  
  ### CASE 2: ALL ASVs (ABUND TABLE)
  ### -----------------------------
  if (type == "_all") {


    
    file_super <- file.path(base_dir2, "OTU_tab_global_ASVs", subsample_group,        # e.g. "all_reads"
                            "Zmock",  primerset_name,         # e.g. "V1V3"
                            "super_OTUtab.txt")

      file_pacbio <- file.path(
        base_dir2,"OTU_tab_global_ASVs",  subsample_group,    "Zmock",  primerset_name,    "pacbio_OTUtab.txt"
      )

    
    #print("hi")
    df_super <- read_asv_table(file_super, "super") %>%
      mutate(
        global_asv_id = OTU,
        basecalling = "super",
        primerset = primerset_name,
        subsampling_group = paste0("sample_size_", subsample_group),
        sample_content = "Zmock"
      ) %>%
      select(-OTU)# %>%
      #left_join(global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match) #%>%
      #select(-ASV_ID)

    df_pacbio <- read_asv_table(file_pacbio, "pacbio") %>%
      mutate(
        global_asv_id = OTU,
        basecalling = "pacbio",
        primerset = primerset_name,
        subsampling_group = paste0("sample_size_", subsample_group),
        sample_content = "Zmock"
      ) %>%
      select(-OTU) #%>%
      #left_join(global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match) %>%
      #select(-ASV_ID)
    
    # Combine super + pacbio
  df_combined <- full_join(df_super, df_pacbio) %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with(c("barcode")), ~ replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    filter(global_asv_id %in% unlist(global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>% distinct(global_asv_id))) %>% 
    distinct()
  }

    # Rename barcode columns (safe)
  barcode_cols <- grep("barcode", names(df_combined), value = TRUE)
  names(df_combined)[names(df_combined) %in% barcode_cols] <- paste0(barcode_cols, type)
  
  abun <- 
    df_combined %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = contains("barcode")) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = c(basecalling, name), values_from = value, values_fill = 0) %>% 
    select(contains("barcode"), global_asv_id) %>% 
    filter(!global_asv_id %in% unlist(lenght_df$global_asv_id)) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("global_asv_id") %>% 
    #select(-ref_name) %>% 
    as.matrix()

  
  meta_data <- global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>%
    distinct(primerset, basecalling, sample_content) %>% 
    left_join(new_barcode, relationship = "many-to-many") %>% 
    mutate(SampleID = paste0(basecalling, "_", barcode, type)) %>% 
    relocate(SampleID)
    
  d_amp <- amp_load(
    otutable = abun, 
    metadata = meta_data
  )
  
  d_amp
}
```

## OTU tab {.tabset}

### Function 

```{r}

run_diversity_pipeline <- function(
  base_dir,
  base_dir2,
  primerset_name,
  subsample_group = "all_reads",
  global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match,
  new_barcode,
  type = "_all",
  rarefy_depth = NULL,
  seq_method_colors = c("#CC007A", "#0077B6"),
  test_vec = c("barcode", "basecalling")
) {
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ampvis2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(rstatix)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(forcats)

  # === 1. Load ampvis object ===
  amp_obj <- read_and_format_to_amp_object(
    base_dir = base_dir,
    base_dir2 = base_dir2,
    primerset_name = primerset_name,
    subsample_group = subsample_group,
    global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match = global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>% filter(!global_asv_id %in% unlist(lenght_df$global_asv_id)) 
,
    new_barcode = new_barcode,
    type = type
  )

  # === (optional) rarefy ===
  if (!is.null(rarefy_depth)) {
    amp_obj <- amp_obj %>% amp_subset_samples(rarefy = rarefy_depth)
  }

  # === 2. Fix metadata ===
  amp_obj$metadata <- amp_obj$metadata %>%
    mutate(
      type = sub(".*_", "", SampleID),
      abun_tab = case_when(
        type == "all" ~ "-otutab",
        type == "exact" ~ "-search_exact"
      ),
      basecalling = factor(basecalling,
                           levels = c("pacbio", "super"),
                           labels = c("PacBio", "ONT"))
    )

  # === 3. Alpha diversity ===
  amp_alpha_div <- amp_obj %>% amp_alpha_diversity()

  plots_list <- amp_alpha_div %>%
    select(-Simpson) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(uniqueOTUs, Shannon, invSimpson)) %>%
    group_split(name)

  make_plot <- function(df) {
    name <- unique(df$name)

    test_res <- df %>%
      arrange(barcode) %>% 
      rstatix::pairwise_t_test(value ~ basecalling,
                               #paired = TRUE, 
                               detailed = T, 
                               #id = barcode,
                               p.adjust.method = "BH")

    comparisons <- list(c("PacBio", "ONT"))
    
    print(test_res)

    ggplot(
      df %>% mutate(x = ""),
      aes(
        x = basecalling,
        y = value,
        color = basecalling,
        group = barcode
      )
    ) +
      geom_point(
        position = position_jitterdodge(
          seed = 1,
          jitter.width = 0.45,
          dodge.width = 0.6
        ),
        size = 2.8,
        stroke = 0.8
      ) +
      ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
        comparisons = comparisons,
        method = "t.test", #paired = T,
        label = "p.signif", 
        tip_length = unit(5, "mm"),
        hide.ns = FALSE,
        label.y = max(df$value) * 1.05
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = seq_method_colors) +
      guides(color = "none", shape = "none") +
      ylab(name) +
      theme_marie_clean() +
      theme(
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(0, max(df$value) * 1.2),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
      )
  }

  plot_list <- lapply(plots_list, make_plot)
  alpha_patchwork <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3, guides = "collect")

  # === 4. LONG DATA ===
  df_long <- amp_obj %>%
    amp_subset_samples(normalise = TRUE) %>%
    amp_export_long()

  # === 5. Compute OTU rank table ===
  otu_rank_table <- df_long %>%
    group_by(OTU) %>%
    summarise(mean_abun = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abun), OTU) %>%
    mutate(ASV_rank = row_number())

  # === 6. Heatmap ===
  bin_colors <- c("#FFF5EB", "#F5C9B0", "#EC9E75", "#E2733B", "#D94801")

  hm <- df_long %>%
    left_join(otu_rank_table, by = "OTU") %>%
    mutate(is_ref = OTU %in%
             (global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>%
                filter(Match_type == "Exact") %>%
                pull(global_asv_id))) %>%
    left_join(
      global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>%
        select(global_asv_id, species, copynumber) %>%
        rename("OTU" = "global_asv_id")
        #rename("global_asv_id" = "OTU")
    ) %>%
    group_by(OTU, basecalling, species, copynumber, ASV_rank, is_ref) %>%
    summarise(mean_abun_2 = mean(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      OTU_clean = paste0("ASV", ASV_rank),
      # OTU_label = if_else(
      #   is_ref,
      #   paste0(species, "; ", OTU, " (n=", copynumber, ")"),
      #   OTU
      # ),
     OTU_label = if_else(
        is_ref,
        paste0(species, "; ", str_replace(str_remove(OTU, primerset_name), "_GZOTU", "ASV"), " (n=", copynumber, ")"),
        str_replace(str_remove(OTU, primerset_name), "_GZOTU", "ASV")
      ),
     # OTU_label = if_else(
     #    OTU %in% c(unlist(lenght_df$global_asv_id), unlist(uchime_positives_zmock$global_asv_id)),
     #    paste0("•", OTU_label),
     #    OTU_label
     #  ),
      mean_abun_2 = if_else(mean_abun_2 == 0, NA, mean_abun_2)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(ASV_rank)) %>% 
    mutate(OTU_label = fct_inorder(OTU_label)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = basecalling, y = OTU_label, fill = mean_abun_2)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = if_else(mean_abun_2 == 0, "-", sprintf("%.1f", mean_abun_2))), size = 3.5) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = bin_colors, na.value = "grey90") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Relative\nabundance (%)") +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, , color = "black"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  

  df_long_ <- df_long %>% as_tibble() %>% 
      group_by(SampleID) %>% 
      mutate(mapped_reads = sum(count)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(SampleID, OTU) %>% 
      mutate(rel_abun_ASV = sum(count)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(SampleID, Species) %>% 
      mutate(rel_abun_species = sum(rel_abun_ASV)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(SampleID, Genus) %>% 
      mutate(rel_abun_genus = sum(rel_abun_ASV)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
      # nest(samples = c(OTU, mapped_reads, count, Genus, Species,
      #                  rel_abun_ASV, rel_abun_species, rel_abun_genus)) %>% 
      left_join(new_barcode) %>% 
      mutate(method_primerset = paste0(basecalling, ";",primerset), 
             basecalling_new_barcode = paste0(basecalling, ";", new_barcode), 
             )
  
  adonis_results <- ADONIS_from_long_df(
    data = df_long_,
    tax_level = "OTU", 
    abun_limit = 0,
    test_varibles = test_vec
)
  print(adonis_results)
  

  # === 7. Beta diversity ===
  beta_div <- amp_obj %>%
    amp_ordinate(
      sample_color_by = "basecalling",
      sample_shape_by = "barcode",
      transform = "none",
      type = "PCOA",
      distmeasure = "bray",
      filter_species = 0,
      sample_label_size = 0
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 3.3, stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = seq_method_colors) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Sequencing platform", nrow = 1),
           shape = "none") +
    theme_marie_clean() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))

  # === 8. Combine ===
  right_side <- alpha_patchwork / beta_div  + plot_layout(heights = c(1.3, 1))
  final_patchwork <- hm | right_side
  final_patchwork <- final_patchwork + plot_layout(widths = c(0.4, 1)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

  
  return(list(
    amp_obj = amp_obj,
    alpha_plots = alpha_patchwork,
    heatmap = hm,
    beta = beta_div,
    combined = final_patchwork
  ))
}
```

### Function  V2

```{r}

run_diversity_pipeline_v2 <- function(
  base_dir,
  base_dir2,
  primerset_name,
  subsample_group = "all_reads",
  global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match,
  new_barcode,
  type = "_all",
  rarefy_depth = NULL,
  seq_method_colors = c("#CC007A", "#0077B6"),
  n_permutations = 9999
) {

  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(tidyverse)
    library(ampvis2)
    library(patchwork)
    library(rstatix)
    library(ggpubr)
    library(forcats)
    library(vegan)
    library(permute)
  })

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper functions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  p_to_significance <- function(p) {
    case_when(
      is.na(p)  ~ "NA",
      p <= 1e-4 ~ "****",
      p <= 1e-3 ~ "***",
      p <= 1e-2 ~ "**",
      p <= 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE      ~ "ns"
    )
  }

  format_p_value <- function(p) {
    if (is.na(p)) {
      return("NA")
    }

    if (p < 0.001) {
      return("< 0.001")
    }

    paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p))
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Load ampvis object
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  amp_obj <- read_and_format_to_amp_object(
    base_dir = base_dir,
    base_dir2 = base_dir2,
    primerset_name = primerset_name,
    subsample_group = subsample_group,
    global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match = global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match,
    new_barcode = new_barcode,
    type = type
  )

  # Optional rarefaction
  if (!is.null(rarefy_depth)) {
    amp_obj <- amp_obj %>%
      amp_subset_samples(rarefy = rarefy_depth)
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Format metadata
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  amp_obj$metadata <- amp_obj$metadata %>%
    mutate(
      type = sub(".*_", "", SampleID),

      abun_tab = case_when(
        type == "all"   ~ "-otutab",
        type == "exact" ~ "-search_exact",
        TRUE            ~ NA_character_
      ),

      basecalling = factor(
        basecalling,
        levels = c("pacbio", "super"),
        labels = c("PacBio", "ONT")
      ),

      barcode = factor(barcode)
    )

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Alpha diversity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  amp_alpha_div <- amp_obj %>%
    amp_alpha_diversity()

  plots_list <- amp_alpha_div %>%
    select(-Simpson) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(uniqueOTUs, Shannon, invSimpson),
      names_to = "name",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      name = case_when(
        str_detect(name, "Shannon") ~ "Shannon",
        str_detect(name, "invSimp") ~ "Inverse Simpson",
        str_detect(name, "unique") ~ "Unique ASVs", .default = NA
      )
    ) %>% 
    group_split(name)

  make_alpha_plot <- function(df) {

    metric_name <- unique(df$name)

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        basecalling = factor(
          basecalling,
          levels = c("PacBio", "ONT")
        ),
        barcode = factor(barcode)
      ) %>%
      arrange(barcode, basecalling)

    
  test_values <- df %>%
  select(barcode, basecalling, value) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = basecalling,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  drop_na(PacBio, ONT)

all_values <- c(
  test_values$PacBio,
  test_values$ONT
)

alpha_p <- if (nrow(test_values) < 2) {

  NA_real_

} else if (dplyr::n_distinct(all_values) == 1) {

  # All values across both groups are identical
  1

} else {

  tryCatch(
    t.test(
      test_values$PacBio,
      test_values$ONT,
      paired = FALSE,
      var.equal = FALSE
    )$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}

y_max <- max(df$value, na.rm = TRUE)

alpha_test <- tibble(
  group1 = "PacBio",
  group2 = "ONT",
  p = alpha_p,
  p.signif = p_to_significance(alpha_p),
  y.position = y_max * 1.08
)

    ggplot(
      df,
      aes(
        x = basecalling,
        y = value,
        color = basecalling
      )
    ) +
      # Connect matched PCR replicates
      # geom_line(
      #   aes(group = barcode),
      #   color = "grey70",
      #   linewidth = 0.45
      # ) +
      geom_jitter(
        width = 0.08,
        height = 0,
        size = 2.4,
        alpha = 0.85
      ) +
      # geom_point(
      #   size = 2.8,
      #   stroke = 0.8
      # ) +
      ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
        alpha_test,
        label = "p.signif",
        xmin = "group1",
        xmax = "group2",
        y.position = "y.position",
        tip.length = 0.02,
        hide.ns = FALSE,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = seq_method_colors
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(0, y_max * 1.20),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
      ) +
      labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = metric_name,
        title = "B"
      ) +
      guides(
        color = "none"
      ) +
      theme_marie_clean() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          angle = 0,
          hjust = 0.5
        ),
        plot.title = element_text(
        size = 20,
        hjust = 0
      )
      )
  }

  plot_list <- lapply(
    plots_list,
    make_alpha_plot
  )

  alpha_patchwork <- wrap_plots(
    plot_list,
    ncol = 3,
    guides = "collect", 
  )

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Export normalized long-format abundance data
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  df_long <- amp_obj %>%
    amp_subset_samples(normalise = TRUE) %>%
    amp_export_long() %>%
    as_tibble()

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Calculate OTU rank
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  otu_rank_table <- df_long %>%
    group_by(OTU) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_abun = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(mean_abun),
      OTU
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ASV_rank = row_number()
    )

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Heatmap
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  bin_colors <- c(
    "#FFF5EB",
    "#F5C9B0",
    "#EC9E75",
    "#E2733B",
    "#D94801"
  )

  exact_reference_ids <- global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>%
    filter(Match_type == "Exact") %>%
    pull(global_asv_id)

  reference_information <- global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>%
    select(
      global_asv_id,
      species,
      copynumber
    ) %>%
    rename(
      OTU = global_asv_id
    )

  # IDs marked with a bullet in the heatmap
  flagged_ids <- c(
    unlist(lenght_df$global_asv_id)
    # ,
    # unlist(uchime_positives_zmock$global_asv_id)
  )

  heatmap_data <- df_long %>%
    left_join(
      otu_rank_table,
      by = "OTU"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      is_ref = OTU %in% exact_reference_ids
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      reference_information,
      by = "OTU"
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      OTU,
      basecalling,
      species,
      copynumber,
      ASV_rank,
      is_ref
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_abun_2 = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      OTU_clean = paste0(
        "ASV",
        ASV_rank
      ),

      OTU_label = if_else(
        is_ref,
        paste0(
          species,
          "; ",
          str_replace(
            str_remove(OTU, primerset_name),
            "_GZOTU",
            "ASV"
          ),
          " (n=",
          copynumber,
          ")"
        ),
        str_replace(
          str_remove(OTU, primerset_name),
          "_GZOTU",
          "ASV"
        )
      ),

      # OTU_label = if_else(
      #   OTU %in% flagged_ids,
      #   paste0("•", OTU_label),
      #   OTU_label
      # ),

      mean_abun_2 = if_else(
        mean_abun_2 == 0,
        NA_real_,
        mean_abun_2
      ),

      heatmap_label = if_else(
        is.na(mean_abun_2),
        "0",
        sprintf("%.1f", mean_abun_2)
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(ASV_rank)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      OTU_label = fct_inorder(OTU_label)
    )

  hm <- ggplot(
    heatmap_data,
    aes(
      x = basecalling,
      y = OTU_label,
      fill = mean_abun_2
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile(
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = heatmap_label),
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = bin_colors,
      na.value = "white"
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Relative\nabundance (%)", 
      title = "A"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(
      base_size = 12
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 12,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 12,
        color = "black"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 20,
        hjust = 0
      ),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. Construct sample-by-ASV matrix for beta diversity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  beta_wide <- df_long %>%
    group_by(
      SampleID,
      OTU
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      abundance = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = OTU,
      values_from = abundance,
      values_fill = 0
    )

  beta_metadata <- amp_obj$metadata %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    distinct(
      SampleID,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    ) %>%
    filter(
      SampleID %in% beta_wide$SampleID
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      basecalling = factor(
        basecalling,
        levels = c("PacBio", "ONT")
      ),
      barcode = factor(barcode)
    )

  # Match metadata order to abundance-matrix order
  beta_metadata <- beta_metadata[
    match(
      beta_wide$SampleID,
      beta_metadata$SampleID
    ),
  ]

  stopifnot(
    identical(
      beta_wide$SampleID,
      beta_metadata$SampleID
    )
  )

  beta_matrix <- beta_wide %>%
    select(-SampleID) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  rownames(beta_matrix) <- beta_wide$SampleID

  bray_dist <- vegan::vegdist(
    beta_matrix,
    method = "bray"
  )

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. Paired PERMANOVA
  #
  # barcode is included as a blocking term in the model.
  # Permutations are restricted within each barcode.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  permutation_design <- permute::how(
    nperm = n_permutations,
    blocks = beta_metadata$barcode
  )

  adonis_results <- vegan::adonis2(
    beta_matrix ~ barcode + basecalling,
    data = beta_metadata,
    method = "bray",
    permutations = permutation_design,

  )

  print(adonis_results)

  platform_row <- which(

replicate_r2 <- adonis_results[

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  dispersion_model <- vegan::betadisper(
    bray_dist,

  )

    dispersion_model,

  )

  print(dispersion_results)

  dispersion_p <- dispersion_results$tab[
    1,
    "Pr(>F)"
  ]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 10. PCoA
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  pcoa_model <- vegan::wcmdscale(
    bray_dist,
    k = 2,
    eig = TRUE,
    add = "lingoes"
  )

  beta_scores <- as.data.frame(
    pcoa_model$points[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
  )

  colnames(beta_scores) <- c(
    "PCo1",
    "PCo2"
  )

  beta_scores <- beta_scores %>%
    rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
    left_join(
      beta_metadata,
      by = "SampleID"
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      barcode,
      basecalling
    )

  positive_eigenvalues <- pcoa_model$eig[
    pcoa_model$eig > 0
  ]

  pcoa1_variance <- 100 *
    positive_eigenvalues[1] /
    sum(positive_eigenvalues)

  pcoa2_variance <- 100 *
    positive_eigenvalues[2] /
    sum(positive_eigenvalues)

  # beta_subtitle <- paste0(
  #   "PERMANOVA: R² = ",
  #   sprintf("%.3f", platform_r2),
  #   ", P ",
  #   format_p_value(platform_p),

#   "Tech. rep. R² = ", sprintf("%.2f", replicate_r2), 
#       "; P = ", sprintf("%.3f", barcode_p)
# )
  

  beta_div <- ggplot(
    beta_scores,
    aes(
      x = PCo1,
      y = PCo2
    )
  )  +
  #   annotate(
  #   "text",

    # ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        color = basecalling,
        shape = barcode
      ),
      size = 3.3,
      stroke = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = seq_method_colors
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        title = "Sequencing platform",
        nrow = 1
      ),
      shape = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = paste0(
        "PCo1 [",
        sprintf("%.1f", pcoa1_variance),
        "%]"
      ),
      y = paste0(
        "PCo2 [",
        sprintf("%.1f", pcoa2_variance),
        "%]"
      ),
      title = "C",
      #subtitle = beta_subtitle
    ) +
    theme_marie_clean() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 0,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 9,
        hjust = 0
      ), 
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 20,
        hjust = 0
      )
    )

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 11. Supplementary comparison of Bray-Curtis distances
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  distance_matrix <- as.matrix(bray_dist)

get_within_platform_distances <- function(platform_name) {

  sample_ids <- beta_metadata %>%
    filter(basecalling == platform_name) %>%
    pull(SampleID)

  sample_pairs <- combn(
    sample_ids,
    2,
    simplify = FALSE
  )

  map_dfr(
    sample_pairs,
    function(sample_pair) {
      tibble(
        comparison = "Within\nplatforms",
        platform_type = platform_name,
        sample_1 = sample_pair[1],
        sample_2 = sample_pair[2],
        distance = distance_matrix[sample_pair[1], sample_pair[2]]
      )
    }
  )
}

matched_distances <- beta_metadata %>%
  select(SampleID, barcode, basecalling) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = basecalling,
    values_from = SampleID
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(PacBio), !is.na(ONT)) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = "Between\nplatforms",
    platform_type = "Matched",
    distance = map2_dbl(
      PacBio,
      ONT,
      function(pacbio_sample, ont_sample) {
        distance_matrix[pacbio_sample, ont_sample]
      }
    )
  ) %>%
  select(comparison, platform_type, barcode, distance)

distance_data <- bind_rows(
  get_within_platform_distances("PacBio"),
  get_within_platform_distances("ONT"),
  matched_distances
) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = factor(
      comparison,
      levels = c("Within\nplatforms", "Between\nplatforms")
    )
  )

#         size = 20,
#         hjust = 0
#       )
#   )
  
  
  y_max <- max(distance_data$distance, na.rm = TRUE)
y_range <- diff(range(distance_data$distance, na.rm = TRUE))

distance_plot <- ggplot(
  distance_data,
  aes(x = comparison, y = distance, color = platform_type)
) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.08,
    height = 0,
    size = 2.4,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    data = distance_data,
    mapping = aes(x = comparison, y = distance),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    comparisons = list(
      c("Within\nplatforms", "Between\nplatforms")
    ),
    method = "t.test",
    method.args = list(var.equal = FALSE),  # Welch's t-test
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y = y_max + 0.08 * y_range,
    tip.length = 0.015,
    bracket.size = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(0, y_max * 1.20),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
      ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "PacBio" = "#CC007A",
      "ONT" = "#0077B6",
      "Matched" = "black"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Bray–Curtis dissimilarity",
    title = "D"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(NA, y_max + 0.18 * y_range),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  theme_marie_clean() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0)
  )
  
  

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 12. Combine main figure
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  bottom_row <- (beta_div | distance_plot) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1))

alpha_patchwork_wid <- alpha_patchwork +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1))

right_side <- (alpha_patchwork_wid / bottom_row) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))

final_patchwork <- (
  (hm + labs(title = "A")) | right_side
) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.37, 1))


  
#  bottom_row <- beta_div | distance_plot + plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1))
#  alpha_patchwork_wid <- alpha_patchwork + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1))
#  # +
#  # plot_layout(widths = c(1.1, 0.8))
#
#right_side <- alpha_patchwork_wid  / bottom_row 
## +
##   plot_layout(heights = c(1.3, 1))
#
#final_patchwork <- (hm + labs(title = "A")) | right_side
#
#final_patchwork <- final_patchwork +
#  plot_layout(widths = c(0.37, 1)) 
## +
#   plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. Return results
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  return(
    list(
      amp_obj = amp_obj,
      alpha_data = amp_alpha_div,
      alpha_plots = alpha_patchwork,
      heatmap_data = heatmap_data,
      heatmap = hm,
      beta_matrix = beta_matrix,
      bray_distance = bray_dist,
      adonis = adonis_results,
      dispersion_model = dispersion_model,
      dispersion = dispersion_results,
      beta_scores = beta_scores,
      beta = beta_div,
      distance_data = distance_data,
      distance_plot = distance_plot,
      combined = final_patchwork
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}

 
combined_amp_long <- function(primer = "V1V8", rarefy_num = 228951){
# === 1. Load ampvis object ===
  amp_obj <- read_and_format_to_amp_object(
    base_dir = base_dir,
    base_dir2 =  paste0(WD, "/results/"),
    primerset_name = {{primer}}, #"V1V8",
    subsample_group = "all_reads",
    global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match = global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>% filter(!global_asv_id %in% unlist(lenght_df$global_asv_id)),
    new_barcode = new_barcode,
    type = "_all"
  )

  amp_obj <- amp_obj %>% amp_subset_samples(rarefy = {{rarefy_num}}) %>% 
    amp_subset_taxa(tax_vector = unlist(lenght_df$global_asv_id), remove = T) 

  # === 2. Fix metadata ===
  amp_obj$metadata <- amp_obj$metadata %>%
    mutate(
      type = sub(".*_", "", SampleID),
      abun_tab = case_when(
        type == "all" ~ "-otutab",
        type == "exact" ~ "-search_exact"
      ),
      basecalling = factor(basecalling,
                           levels = c("pacbio", "super"),
                           labels = c("PacBio", "ONT")), 
    )

# === 4. LONG DATA ===
  df_long <- amp_obj %>%
    amp_subset_samples(normalise = TRUE) %>%
    amp_export_long()
  
}


df_long_comp <- 
  rbind(
    combined_amp_long(primer = "V1V8", rarefy = 228951),
    combined_amp_long(primer = "V1V3", rarefy = 24668),
    combined_amp_long(primer = "V4", rarefy = 7173),
    combined_amp_long(primer = "OPR", rarefy = 54149)
    ) %>% 
  mutate(is_ref = OTU %in%
             (global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>%
                filter(Match_type == "Exact") %>%
                pull(global_asv_id))) %>% 
  filter(!OTU %in% unlist(lenght_df$global_asv_id)) 

  # === 5. Compute OTU rank table ===
  otu_rank_table_PB <- df_long_comp %>%
    filter(basecalling == "PacBio") %>% 
    group_by(OTU, primerset, new_barcode, is_ref) %>%
    summarise(mean_abun_PB = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abun_PB), OTU) %>%
    mutate(ASV_rank_PB = row_number())

  
  otu_rank_table_ONT <- df_long_comp %>%
    filter(basecalling == "ONT") %>% 
    group_by(OTU, primerset, new_barcode, is_ref) %>%
    summarise(mean_abun_ONT = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abun_ONT), OTU) %>%
    mutate(ASV_rank_ONT = row_number())
  
asv_mean_abundance <- full_join(otu_rank_table_ONT, otu_rank_table_PB) 

# Individual PCR-replicate observations
replicate_abundance <- full_join(
  otu_rank_table_ONT,
  otu_rank_table_PB,
  by = c("OTU", "primerset", "new_barcode", "is_ref")
) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_abun_ONT = replace_na(mean_abun_ONT, 0),
    mean_abun_PB  = replace_na(mean_abun_PB, 0),
    is_ref = factor(
      is_ref,
      levels = c(TRUE, FALSE),
      labels = c("Reference ASV", "Non-reference ASV")
    ),
    primerset = factor(primerset, levels = c("V4", "V1V3", "V1V8", "OPR"), 
                       labels = c("V4", "V1-V3", "V1-V8", "OPR"))
  )

# Mean across the four PCR replicates
asv_mean_abundance <- replicate_abundance %>%
  group_by(primerset, OTU, is_ref) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abun_ONT = mean(mean_abun_ONT, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abun_PB  = mean(mean_abun_PB, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

correlation_results <- asv_mean_abundance %>%
  group_by(primerset) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    test <- cor.test(
      .x$mean_abun_ONT,
      .x$mean_abun_PB,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )

    tibble(
      rho = unname(test$estimate),
      p_value = test$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "Spearman's \u03c1 = ", sprintf("%.3f", rho),
      "\n P", format.pval(
        p_value,
        digits = 2,
        eps = 0.001,
        prefix = "P "
      )
    )
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # Individual PCR replicates
  # geom_point(
  #   data = replicate_abundance,
  #   aes(
  #     x = mean_abun_ONT,
  #     y = mean_abun_PB,
  #     color = is_ref
  #   ),
  #   size = 1.3,
  #   alpha = 0.20
  # ) +

  # Mean across PCR replicates
  geom_point(
    data = asv_mean_abundance,
    aes(
      x = mean_abun_ONT,
      y = mean_abun_PB,
      color = is_ref
    ),
    size = 2.6,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = correlation_results,
    aes(
      x = Inf,
      y = -Inf,
      label = label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1.08,
    vjust = -0.45,
    size = 4.5
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ primerset,
    scales = "free"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Reference ASV" = "#159A9C",
      "Non-reference ASV" = "#D66B5D"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Mean relative abundance, ONT (%)",
    y = "Mean relative abundance, PacBio (%)"
  ) +

  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        alpha = 1,
        size = 2.5
      )
    )
  ) +

  theme_marie_clean() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 1,
      angle = 0
    ),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

plot_name="Fig_S7_correlation_abundance_zmock"
plot_folder=folder_dir_supp
ggsave(paste0(plot_dir ,plot_folder, "/", plot_name, ".svg"), width = 9, height =7 )
ggsave(paste0(plot_dir ,plot_folder, "/", plot_name, ".png"), width = 9, height =7)

# Correlation between ASV relative abundances obtained using ONT and PacBio sequencing. Small translucent points represent individual technical PCR replicates, whereas larger points represent the mean relative abundance across the four replicates. Colours distinguish ASVs with and without an exact match to the reference sequences. The dashed line represents equal relative abundance between sequencing platforms. Spearman correlations were calculated from the replicate-averaged ASV abundances separately for each primer set.
```

```{r}
files <- list.files(indir, pattern = "_exact.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Helper function to parse names from filename
parse_filename <- function(path) {
  name <- basename(path) %>% 
    str_remove("_exact.tsv$")
  
  tibble(
    basecalling  = ifelse(str_detect(name, "^super"), "super", "pacbio"), # adjust if needed
    primerset    = str_extract(name, "OPR|V1V3|V1V8|V4"),
    sample_content = str_extract(name, "WWTP|AD|Soil|Zfecal|Zmock"),
    subsampling_group = ifelse(str_detect(path, "big"), "sample_size_5000000","sample_size_2000000")
  )
}


# Read + parse all files
global_ASVs_all_load_new_subsets <- map_dfr(files, function(f) {
  
  # Load exact matches
  df <- read_tsv(f, col_names = c("ASV_ID", "global_asv_id", "percent_id"),
                 col_types = "ccc")
  
  # Parse metadata from filename
  meta <- parse_filename(f)
  
  # Add metadata columns
  df %>%
    mutate(
      basecalling = meta$basecalling,
      primerset = meta$primerset,
      sample_content = meta$sample_content,
      subsampling_group = meta$subsampling_group
    ) %>%
    select(ASV_ID, basecalling, primerset, sample_content, subsampling_group, global_asv_id) %>% 
    mutate(global_asv_id = sub(";.*", "", global_asv_id))
})
```

```{r}
df <- plot_data %>%

####################################################################
# 1. Linear-phase filter per primer
####################################################################

get_linear_filter <- function(df) {
  prim <- unique(df$primerset)
  if (length(prim) != 1) stop("get_linear_filter() expects a single primerset.")

  if (prim == "V4") {
    df %>% filter(n_ASV >= 1)

  } else if (prim %in% c("V1-V3", "V1-V8", "OPR")) {
    df %>% filter(n_ASV >= 2)

  } else df
}

#get_linear_filter(df = dat)

####################################################################
# 2. Fit linear-phase model
####################################################################

fit_linear_phase <- function(df) {
  df_lin <- get_linear_filter(df)

  if (nrow(df_lin) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  #df_lin = dat

  mod <- lm(n_ASV ~ log10(reads_used), data = df_lin)

  pred_df <- tibble(
    reads_used = seq(min(df_lin$reads_used),
                     max(df_lin$reads_used), length.out = 200),
    log_reads  = log10(reads_used),
    pred_nASV  = predict(mod, newdata = tibble(log_reads = log10(seq(min(df_lin$reads_used),
                                                                     max(df_lin$reads_used),
                                                                     length.out = 200))))
  )
  pred_df$basecalling <- unique(df$basecalling)

  list(
    df_linear = df_lin,
    model     = mod,
    pred      = pred_df
  )
}

#fit_linear_phase(dat)

fit_loglog_phase <- function(df) {
  # Same primer-based filtering as before
  df_lin <- get_linear_filter(df) %>% 
    filter(n_ASV > 0) %>%              # cannot take log10(0)
    mutate(
      log_reads = log10(reads_used),
      log_ASV   = log10(n_ASV)
    )

  if (nrow(df_lin) < 2) return(NULL)

  mod <- lm(log_ASV ~ log_reads, data = df_lin)

  pred_df <- tibble(
    reads_used = seq(min(df_lin$reads_used),
                     max(df_lin$reads_used), length.out = 200)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      log_reads      = log10(reads_used),
      pred_log_ASV   = predict(mod, newdata = cur_data()),
      pred_nASV      = 10^pred_log_ASV,     # back-transform for plotting
      basecalling    = unique(df$basecalling)
    )

  list(
    df_linear = df_lin,
    model     = mod,
    pred      = pred_df
  )
}


####################################################################
# 3. Compute #reads needed for ASV = 1
####################################################################

compute_reads_for_asv1 <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)

  slope <- coef(fit$model)[2]
  intercept <- coef(fit$model)[1]

  if (slope <= 0) return(NA_real_)

  reads <- 10^((1 - intercept) / slope)
  reads
}

compute_reads_for_asv <- function(fit, target_ASV = 1) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  a <- coef(fit$model)[1]   # intercept (log_ASV)
  b <- coef(fit$model)[2]   # slope

  if (b <= 0) return(NA_real_)

  log_target <- log10(target_ASV)
  log_reads  <- (log_target - a) / b
  10^log_reads
}


####################################################################
# 4. Extract slope, R², mean reads-per-ASV
####################################################################

extract_metrics <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  df_lin <- fit$df_linear
  slope  <- coef(fit$model)[2]
  intercept <- coef(fit$model)[1]
  r2 <- summary(fit$model)$r.squared
  rpASV <- df_lin$reads_used / df_lin$n_ASV

  tibble(
    slope = slope,
    intercept = intercept,
    r2 = r2,
    mean_reads_per_ASV = mean(rpASV),
    median_reads_per_ASV = median(rpASV)
  )
}


####################################################################
# 5. MAIN PLOT FUNCTION (PacBio + ONT for one primer × sample_content)
####################################################################
#primerset = "V4"
#sample_content = "Zfecal"
plot_paired_linear <- function(df, primerset, sample_content) {

  dat <- df %>%
    filter(primerset == {{primerset}} &
           sample_content == {{sample_content}})
  
  print(dat)

  #pb  <- dat %>% filter(basecalling == "Pacbio") %>% fit_linear_phase()
  #ont <- dat %>% filter(basecalling == "ONT")    %>% fit_linear_phase()
  
  pb  <- dat %>% filter(basecalling == "Pacbio") %>% fit_loglog_phase()
  ont <- dat %>% filter(basecalling == "ONT")    %>% fit_loglog_phase()

  pb_metrics  <- extract_metrics(pb)
  ont_metrics <- extract_metrics(ont)

  #pb_reads1  <- compute_reads_for_asv1(pb)
  #ont_reads1 <- compute_reads_for_asv1(ont)
  
  pb_reads1  <- compute_reads_for_asv(pb,  target_ASV = 100)
  ont_reads1 <- compute_reads_for_asv(ont, target_ASV = 100)

  
  fold_diff <- if (!is.na(pb_reads1) && !is.na(ont_reads1))
    ont_reads1 / pb_reads1 else NA_real_
  
  #slope_ratio <- pb_metrics$slope / ont_metrics$slope

  # if (slope_ratio >= 1) {
  # rate_text <- paste0("PB ~", signif(slope_ratio, 3), "× faster ASV gain")
  # } else {
  # rate_text <- paste0("ONT ~", signif(1/slope_ratio, 3), "× faster ASV gain")
  # }

  ############################################################
  # Base plot
  ############################################################

  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = reads_used, y = n_ASV, color = basecalling)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.9, fill = "white") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Pacbio"="#CC007A","ONT"="#0077B6")) +
    labs(
      #title = paste0(sample_content, " | ", {{primerset}}),
      x = "Reads (log10 scale)",
      y = "Number of ASVs  (log10 scale)",
      color = "Sequencing platform"
    ) +
    theme_marie_clean() +
    facet_grid(sample_content~primerset) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold"), 
          strip.text = element_blank())

  ############################################################
  # Add fitted lines
  ############################################################

  if (!is.null(pb)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_line(data = pb$pred,
                aes(x = reads_used, y = pred_nASV),
                color = "#CC007A", linewidth = 1.2)
  }

  if (!is.null(ont)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_line(data = ont$pred,
                aes(x = reads_used, y = pred_nASV),
                color = "#0077B6", linewidth = 1.2)
  }

  ############################################################
  # PacBio annotation
  ############################################################

  if (!is.na(pb_reads1)) {
    p <- p +
      annotate("label",
               x = min(dat$reads_used)*1.2,
               y = max(dat$n_ASV)*0.25,
               hjust = 0,
               fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.8),
               label = paste0(
                 "PB: ~", format(round(pb_reads1), big.mark=","),
                 " reads (ASV=100)\nSlope=", signif(pb_metrics$slope,3),
                 ", R²=", signif(pb_metrics$r2,3)
               ),
               color = "#CC007A", size = 3, label.size = 0)
  }

  ############################################################
  # ONT annotation
  ############################################################

  if (!is.na(ont_reads1)) {
    p <- p +
      annotate("label",
               x = 30000,#min(dat$reads_used)*1.2,
               y = 10, #max(dat$n_ASV)*0.83,
               hjust = 0,
               fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.8),
               label = paste0(
                 "ONT: ~", format(round(ont_reads1), big.mark=","),
                 " reads (ASV=100)\nSlope=", signif(ont_metrics$slope,3),
                 ", R²=", signif(ont_metrics$r2,3)
               ),
               color = "#0077B6", size = 3, label.size = 0)
  }

  ############################################################
  # Fold-difference annotation
  ############################################################

  if (!is.na(fold_diff)) {
    p <- p +
      annotate("text",
               x = min(dat$reads_used)*1.2,
               y = max(dat$n_ASV)*1.01,
               hjust = 0,
               label = #rate_text, 
               paste0("ONT requires ~", signif(fold_diff,3),
                                "× more reads (ASV = 100)"),
               color = "black", size = 4)
  }

  return(p)
}
```

```{r}

PCOA_from_long_df <- function(
  data,
  tax_level = "Species",
  abun_limit = 0.1
){
 

  tax_level <- tolower(tax_level)

  # mapping from user input to actual columns
  abun_lookup <- c(
    species = "rel_abun_species",
    genus   = "rel_abun_genus",
    family  = "rel_abun_family",
    order   = "rel_abun_order",
    class   = "rel_abun_class",
    phylum  = "rel_abun_phylum",
    otu = "rel_abun_ASV"
  )

  stopifnot(tax_level %in% names(abun_lookup))

  tax_col  <- tax_level
  abun_col <- abun_lookup[[tax_level]]

  df <- data %>%
  unnest(samples) %>% 
  rename_with(tolower)
  
  df_tax <- df %>%
  group_by(sampleid, tax_level = .data[[tax_col]]) %>%
  distinct(sampleid, tax_level, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  summarise(tax_abun = sum(.data[[abun_col]]), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  #print(df_tax, n = 500)
  filter(!str_detect(tax_level, "unclassified"))
  # 
  top_taxa <- df_tax %>%
  group_by(tax_level) %>%
  summarise(max_abun = max(tax_abun), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(max_abun >= abun_limit) %>%
  pull(tax_level)
  
  df_tax <- df_tax %>% filter(tax_level %in% top_taxa)
  
  abun_matrix <- df_tax %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = tax_level, values_from = tax_abun, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sampleid") %>%
  as.matrix()


  # Bray Curtis + PCoA
  bc <- vegan::vegdist(abun_matrix, method = "bray")
  pcoa <- cmdscale(bc, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)

  pc_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa$points) %>%
    rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
    dplyr::rename( "PCoA1" = V1, "PCoA2" = V2)

  # keep all metadata but DO NOT map to aesthetics
  meta_cols <- data %>%
    distinct(SampleID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(-samples)

  pc_df <- left_join(pc_df, meta_cols, by = "SampleID")

  # raw plot
  expl <- round(100 * pcoa$eig / sum(pcoa$eig), 1)

  g <- ggplot(pc_df, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.1) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = glue::glue("PCoA1 ({expl[1]}%)"),
      y = glue::glue("PCoA2 ({expl[2]}%)")
    )

  return(g)
}
```

```{r, load amp object complex}
base_dir = paste0(WD, "/results/global_ASVs/")
read_sintax_conf80 <- function(file) {
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)

  # 1) Read the SINTAX file: 4 tab-separated columns (id, tax_full, "+", tax_filtered)
  df <- read_tsv(
    file,
    col_names = c("id", "tax_full", "plus", "tax_filtered"),
    col_types = "cccc"#,
    #delim = "\t"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      ASV  = sub(";size.*", "", id),
      size = as.numeric(str_extract(id, "(?<=size=)\\d+"))
    )

  # 2) Extract filtered ranks (right side, already ≥ 0.8)
  get_rank <- function(s, code) {
    x <- str_extract(s, paste0(code, ":[^,]+"))
    str_remove(x, paste0(code, ":"))
  }

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      domain = get_rank(tax_filtered, "d"),
      phylum = get_rank(tax_filtered, "p"),
      class  = get_rank(tax_filtered, "c"),
      order  = get_rank(tax_filtered, "o"),
      family = get_rank(tax_filtered, "f"),
      genus  = get_rank(tax_filtered, "g"),
      species = get_rank(tax_filtered, "s")
    ) %>%
    # 3) Ensure domain exists so downstream fills never crash
    mutate(domain = if_else(is.na(domain), "domain_unknown", domain))

  rank_order <- c("domain","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species")

  # 4) Row-fill helper: fill missing ranks with "unclassified_<rankletter>__<last_good>"
  fill_tax <- function(domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species) {
    ranks <- c(domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species)
    if (is.na(ranks[1])) ranks[1] <- "domain_unknown"

    # last confident rank among domain..genus (1..6)
    present <- which(!is.na(ranks[1:6]))
    last_idx <- if (length(present) == 0) 1 else max(present)
    last_good <- ranks[last_idx]
    last_letter <- c("d","p","c","o","f","g")[last_idx]

    # fill NAs from phylum..species using that last_good
    for (i in 2:7) {
      if (is.na(ranks[i])) {
        ranks[i] <- paste0("unclassified_", last_letter, "__", last_good)
      }
    }
    ranks
  }

  # 5) Apply per-row (returns a list of length-7 vectors); bind back to columns
  filled <- pmap(df[, rank_order], fill_tax)
  filled_mat <- do.call(rbind, filled)
  filled_tbl <- as_tibble(filled_mat, .name_repair = ~ rank_order)
  names(filled_tbl) <- rank_order

  # 6) Final tidy table
  out <- bind_cols(df %>% select(ASV, size), filled_tbl)
  out
}

read_and_format_to_amp_object_complex <- function(
  base_dir,
  base_dir2, #= "/home/bio.aau.dk/hd95lp/Projects/RETHINK/p_nanopore_amplicon/6_snakemake_usearch_run_all",
  tax = tax_globalzutu,
  primerset_name = "V1V3",
  subsample_group = "all_reads",
  sample = "Zfecal",
  global_ASVs_all_load,
  new_barcode,
  type = "_exact"   # all
  ) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(tidyr)

  # Helper to read ASV tables
  read_asv_table <- function(file, method) {
    first <- readLines(file, n = 1)
    if (startsWith(first, "#")) {
      header <- strsplit(sub("^#", "", first), "\t")[[1]]
      df <- read_tsv(file, col_names = header, skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)
    } else {
      df <- read_tsv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    }
    names(df)[1] <- "OTU"
    #names(df)[-1] <- paste0(method, "_", names(df)[-1])
    df
  }

  # Subset glabal ASVs to the actual runs (rather than all)
  # generated_ASV_all_runs <- global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>%
  #   filter(sample_content == sample, primerset == primerset_name) %>% #print(n = 19) %>% 
  #   distinct(basecalling, global_asv_id )
  
 
  ### -----------------------------  
  ### CASE 2: ALL ASVs (ABUND TABLE)
  ### -----------------------------
  if (type == "_all") {


    paste0(base_dir2, "OTU_tab_global_ASVs", subsample_group,        # e.g. "all_reads"
                            sample,  primerset_name,         # e.g. "V1V3"
                            "super_OTUtab.txt")
    file_super <- file.path(base_dir2, "OTU_tab_global_ASVs", subsample_group,        # e.g. "all_reads"
                            sample,  primerset_name,         # e.g. "V1V3"
                            "super_OTUtab.txt")

    file_pacbio <- file.path(
        base_dir2,"OTU_tab_global_ASVs",  subsample_group,    sample,  primerset_name,    "pacbio_OTUtab.txt"
      )

    
    #print("hi")
    df_super <- read_asv_table(file_super, "super") %>%
      mutate(
        global_asv_id = OTU,
        basecalling = "super",
        primerset = primerset_name,
        subsampling_group = paste0("sample_size_", subsample_group),
        sample_content = sample
      ) %>%
      select(-OTU)

    df_pacbio <- read_asv_table(file_pacbio, "pacbio") %>%
      mutate(
        global_asv_id = OTU,
        basecalling = "pacbio",
        primerset = primerset_name,
        subsampling_group = paste0("sample_size_", subsample_group),
        sample_content = sample
      ) %>%
      select(-OTU) 
    
    # Combine super + pacbio
  df_combined <- full_join(df_super, df_pacbio) %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with(c("barcode")), ~ replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    #filter(global_asv_id %in% unlist(global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>% distinct(global_asv_id))) %>% 
    distinct()
  }

    # Rename barcode columns (safe)
  barcode_cols <- grep("barcode", names(df_combined), value = TRUE)
  names(df_combined)[names(df_combined) %in% barcode_cols] <- paste0(barcode_cols, type)
  
  abun <- 
    df_combined %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = contains("barcode")) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = c(basecalling, name), values_from = value, values_fill = 0) %>% 
    select(contains("barcode"), global_asv_id) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("global_asv_id") %>% 
    #select(-ref_name) %>% 
    as.matrix()

  
  meta_data <- global_ASVs_all_load %>%
    filter(
      primerset == primerset_name,
      subsampling_group == paste0("sample_size_", subsample_group),
      sample_content == sample) %>% 
    distinct(primerset, basecalling, sample_content) %>% 
    left_join(new_barcode, relationship = "many-to-many") %>% 
    mutate(SampleID = paste0(basecalling, "_", barcode, type)) %>% 
    relocate(SampleID)
    
  d_amp <- amp_load(
    otutable = abun, 
    metadata = meta_data, 
    taxonomy = tax
  )
  
  d_amp
}
```
