```{r}
run_diversity_pipeline <- function(
  base_dir,
  primerset_name,
  subsample_group = "all_reads",
  global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match,
  new_barcode,
  type = "_all",
  rarefy_depth = NULL,
  seq_method_colors = c("#CC007A", "#0077B6")
) {
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ampvis2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(rstatix)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(forcats)

  # === 1. Load ampvis object ===
  amp_obj <- read_and_format_to_amp_object(
    base_dir = base_dir,
    primerset_name = primerset_name,
    subsample_group = subsample_group,
    global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match = global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match,
    new_barcode = new_barcode,
    type = type
  )

  # === (optional) rarefy ===
  if (!is.null(rarefy_depth)) {
    amp_obj <- amp_obj %>% amp_subset_samples(rarefy = rarefy_depth)
  }

  # === 2. Fix metadata ===
  amp_obj$metadata <- amp_obj$metadata %>%
    mutate(
      type = sub(".*_", "", SampleID),
      abun_tab = case_when(
        type == "all" ~ "-otutab",
        type == "exact" ~ "-search_exact"
      ),
      basecalling = factor(basecalling,
                           levels = c("pacbio", "super"),
                           labels = c("Pacbio", "ONT"))
    )

  # === 3. Alpha diversity ===
  amp_alpha_div <- amp_obj %>% amp_alpha_diversity()

  plots_list <- amp_alpha_div %>%
    select(-Simpson) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(uniqueOTUs, Shannon, invSimpson)) %>%
    group_split(name)

  make_plot <- function(df) {
    name <- unique(df$name)

    test_res <- df %>%
      rstatix::pairwise_t_test(value ~ basecalling,
                               paired = FALSE,
                               p.adjust.method = "BH")

    comparisons <- list(c("Pacbio", "ONT"))

    ggplot(
      df %>% mutate(x = ""),
      aes(
        x = basecalling,
        y = value,
        color = basecalling,
        group = barcode
      )
    ) +
      geom_point(
        position = position_jitterdodge(
          seed = 1,
          jitter.width = 0.45,
          dodge.width = 0.6
        ),
        size = 2.8,
        stroke = 0.8
      ) +
      ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
        comparisons = comparisons,
        method = "t.test", paired = FALSE,
        label = "p.signif",
        tip_length = unit(5, "mm"),
        hide.ns = FALSE,
        label.y = max(df$value) * 1.05
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = seq_method_colors) +
      guides(color = "none", shape = "none") +
      ylab(name) +
      theme_marie_clean() +
      theme(
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(0, max(df$value) * 1.2),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
      )
  }

  plot_list <- lapply(plots_list, make_plot)
  alpha_patchwork <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3, guides = "collect")

  # === 4. LONG DATA ===
  df_long <- amp_obj %>%
    amp_subset_samples(normalise = TRUE) %>%
    amp_export_long()

  # === 5. Compute OTU rank table ===
  otu_rank_table <- df_long %>%
    group_by(OTU) %>%
    summarise(mean_abun = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abun), OTU) %>%
    mutate(ASV_rank = row_number())

  # === 6. Heatmap ===
  bin_colors <- c("#FFF5EB", "#F5C9B0", "#EC9E75", "#E2733B", "#D94801")

  hm <- df_long %>%
    left_join(otu_rank_table, by = "OTU") %>%
    mutate(is_ref = OTU %in%
             (global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>%
                filter(Match_type == "Exact") %>%
                pull(global_asv_id))) %>%
    left_join(
      global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>%
        select(global_asv_id, species, copynumber) %>%
        rename("OTU" = "global_asv_id")
        #rename("global_asv_id" = "OTU")
    ) %>%
    group_by(OTU, basecalling, species, copynumber, ASV_rank, is_ref) %>%
    summarise(mean_abun_2 = mean(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      OTU_clean = paste0("ASV", ASV_rank),
      OTU_label = if_else(
        is_ref,
        paste0(species, "; ", OTU_clean, " (n=", copynumber, ")"),
        OTU_clean
      ), 
      mean_abun_2 = if_else(mean_abun_2 == 0, NA, mean_abun_2)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(ASV_rank)) %>% 
    mutate(OTU_label = fct_inorder(OTU_label)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = basecalling, y = OTU_label, fill = mean_abun_2)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = if_else(mean_abun_2 == 0, "-", sprintf("%.1f", mean_abun_2))), size = 3.5) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = bin_colors, na.value = "grey90") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Relative\nabundance (%)") +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, , color = "black"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  # === 7. Beta diversity ===
  beta_div <- amp_obj %>%
    amp_ordinate(
      sample_color_by = "basecalling",
      sample_shape_by = "barcode",
      transform = "none",
      type = "PCOA",
      distmeasure = "bray",
      filter_species = 0,
      sample_label_size = 0
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 3.3, stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = seq_method_colors) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Sequencing platform", nrow = 1),
           shape = "none") +
    theme_marie_clean() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))

  # === 8. Combine ===
  right_side <- alpha_patchwork / beta_div + plot_layout(heights = c(1.3, 1))
  final_patchwork <- hm | right_side
  final_patchwork <- final_patchwork + plot_layout(widths = c(0.4, 1))

  
  return(list(
    amp_obj = amp_obj,
    alpha_plots = alpha_patchwork,
    heatmap = hm,
    beta = beta_div,
    combined = final_patchwork
  ))
}
```

```{r}
merge_ampvis_samples <- function(
  sample_contents,             # vector: e.g. c("Zfecal", "WWTP", "Biofilm", "AS")
  base_dir,
  primerset_name,
  subsample_group,
  tax,
  global_ASVs_all_load,
  new_barcode,
  type = "_all"
){

  # Load each sample_content as an ampvis object
  amp_list <- lapply(sample_contents, function(sc) {
    read_and_format_to_amp_object_complex(
      base_dir2 = file.path(base_dir),
      primerset_name = primerset_name,
      subsample_group = subsample_group,
      sample = sc,
      tax = tax,
      global_ASVs_all_load = global_ASVs_all_load,
      new_barcode = new_barcode,
      type = type
    )
  })

  # merge all ampvis objects sequentially
  merged_amp <- Reduce(
    f = function(a, b) amp_merge_ampvis2(a, b, by_refseq = FALSE),
    x = amp_list
  )

  return(merged_amp)
}
```

```{r}
seq_method_colors <- c("PacBio" = "#CC007A", "ONT" = "#0077B6")

# --------------------------
# 1. Build the plotting function
# --------------------------

make_alpha_plot <- function(df_metric) {
  
#   metric_name <- unique(df_metric$name)
#   
#   # Wilcoxon test per sample_content
#   pvals <- df_metric %>%
#     group_by(sample_content) %>% 
#     # pairwise_wilcox_test(    
#     #   value ~ basecalling,
#     #   paired = TRUE,
#     #   p.adjust.method = "BH"
#     # ) %>%
#     pairwise_t_test(
#   value ~ basecalling,
#   paired = FALSE,
#   pool.sd = FALSE,
#   var.equal = FALSE,
#   p.adjust.method = "BH"
# ) %>%
#     add_significance("p.adj") %>%
#       mutate(p.signif = p.adj.signif) %>%   # <-- add this line
#     add_xy_position(
#       x = "basecalling",
#       fun = "max",
#       dodge = 0.6
#     )
#   
#   print(pvals)
   p_to_significance <- function(p) {
    case_when(
      is.na(p)  ~ "NA",
      p <= 1e-4 ~ "****",
      p <= 1e-3 ~ "***",
      p <= 1e-2 ~ "**",
      p <= 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE      ~ "ns"
    )
  }

  format_p_value <- function(p) {
    if (is.na(p)) {
      return("NA")
    }

    if (p < 0.001) {
      return("< 0.001")
    }

    paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p))
  }
  
  
  metric_name <- unique(df_metric$name)

# Positions for significance brackets
y_positions <- df_metric %>%
  group_by(sample_content) %>%
  summarise(
    y_max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    y_range = diff(range(value, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = y_max + if_else(
      y_range > 0,
      0.08 * y_range,
      0.08 * pmax(abs(y_max), 1)
    )
  )

# Unpaired Welch's t-test within each sample_content
pvals <- df_metric %>%
  group_by(sample_content) %>%
  group_modify(~ {

    test_data <- .x %>%
      filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(basecalling))

    n_pacbio <- sum(test_data$basecalling == "PacBio")
    n_ont <- sum(test_data$basecalling == "ONT")

    if (n_pacbio < 2 || n_ont < 2) {

      # Insufficient observations
      tibble(
        .y. = "value",
        group1 = "PacBio",
        group2 = "ONT",
        n1 = n_pacbio,
        n2 = n_ont,
        p = NA_real_,
        p.adj = NA_real_
      )

    } else if (n_distinct(test_data$value) == 1) {

      # Every value across both platforms is identical
      tibble(
        .y. = "value",
        group1 = "PacBio",
        group2 = "ONT",
        n1 = n_pacbio,
        n2 = n_ont,
        p = 1,
        p.adj = 1
      )

    } else {

      # Welch's unpaired t-test
      tryCatch(
        {
          test_data %>%
            pairwise_t_test(
              value ~ basecalling,
              paired = FALSE,
              pool.sd = FALSE,
              var.equal = FALSE,
              p.adjust.method = "BH"
            ) %>%
            select(
              .y., group1, group2,
              n1, n2, p, p.adj
            )
        },
        error = function(e) {
          tibble(
            .y. = "value",
            group1 = "PacBio",
            group2 = "ONT",
            n1 = n_pacbio,
            n2 = n_ont,
            p = NA_real_,
            p.adj = NA_real_
          )
        }
      )
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p.signif = p_to_significance(p.adj)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    y_positions %>% select(sample_content, y.position),
    by = "sample_content"
  )
  
  ggplot(
    df_metric,
    aes(
      x = basecalling,
      y = value,
      color = basecalling,
      group = barcode
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.4,
        dodge.width = 0.6
      ),
      size = 3
    ) +
    
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      pvals,
      label = "p.signif",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 4,
      hide.ns = FALSE
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = seq_method_colors) +
    
    facet_grid(
      rows = vars(name),
      cols = vars(sample_content),
      scales = "free_y",
      #switch = "x"
    ) +
    
    ylab(metric_name) +
    xlab(NULL) +
    
    theme_marie_clean(bg = "#ECECEC") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size =13),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size =12),
  
       # Only keep the column strips (AD, Soil, WWTP, Zfecal)
     strip.text.y = element_blank(),
     strip.background.y = element_blank(),
  
    # Keep column strips at the top
    #strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "white")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, max(df_metric$value) * 1.25),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
    )
}
```

```{r}

fig_4B_heatmap_bray <- function(
  amp_objects,
  new_barcode = NULL,
  barcode_join_by = "barcode",
  primer_set,
  pair_id = "new_barcode",
  rarefy_depth = NULL,
  top_n = 30,
  seq_method_colors = c(
    "PacBio" = "#CC007A",
    "ONT" = "#0077B6"
  ),
  sample_order = c(
    "Fecal",
    "AD",
    "WWTP",
    "Soil"
  ),
  p_adjust_method = "BH",
  hide_ns = FALSE
) {

  library(tidyverse)
  library(ampvis2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(rstatix)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(vegan)

  # ------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper functions
  # ------------------------------------------------------

  standardise_platform <- function(x) {

    x <- as.character(x)

    x <- case_when(
      tolower(x) == "pacbio" ~ "PacBio",
      tolower(x) %in% c("super", "ont") ~ "ONT",
      TRUE ~ x
    )

    factor(
      x,
      levels = c("PacBio", "ONT")
    )
  }

  standardise_content <- function(x) {

    recode(
      as.character(x),
      "Zfecal" = "Fecal"
    )
  }

  # Allow unnamed colour vectors
  if (is.null(names(seq_method_colors))) {

    if (length(seq_method_colors) != 2) {
      stop(
        "`seq_method_colors` must contain two colours."
      )
    }

    names(seq_method_colors) <- c(
      "PacBio",
      "ONT"
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------
  # Accept a single ampvis2 object
  # ------------------------------------------------------

  is_single_amp_object <- all(
    c("abund", "metadata") %in%
      names(amp_objects)
  )

  if (is_single_amp_object) {

    if (
      !"sample_content" %in%
        names(amp_objects$metadata)
    ) {
      stop(
        "`amp_obj$metadata` must contain `sample_content`."
      )
    }

    content_label <- amp_objects$metadata %>%
      distinct(sample_content) %>%
      drop_na() %>%
      pull(sample_content) %>%
      standardise_content() %>%
      unique()

    if (length(content_label) != 1) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The supplied ampvis2 object contains multiple ",
          "sample types. Supply one ampvis2 object per ",
          "sample type in a named list."
        )
      )
    }

    amp_objects <- setNames(
      list(amp_objects),
      content_label
    )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------
  # Validate named list
  # ------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    !is.list(amp_objects) ||
      is.null(names(amp_objects)) ||
      any(names(amp_objects) == "")
  ) {
    stop(
      "`amp_objects` must be a named list of ampvis2 objects."
    )
  }

  names(amp_objects) <- standardise_content(
    names(amp_objects)
  )

  sample_levels <- c(
    intersect(
      sample_order,
      names(amp_objects)
    ),
    setdiff(
      names(amp_objects),
      sample_order
    )
  )

  # ======================================================
  # Analyse one sample type independently
  # ======================================================

  analyse_one <- function(
    amp_obj,
    sample_label,
    barcode_data
  ) {

    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # Optional rarefaction
    # ----------------------------------------------------

    if (!is.null(rarefy_depth)) {

      amp_obj <- amp_obj %>%
        amp_subset_samples(
          rarefy = rarefy_depth
        )
    }

    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # Format metadata
    # ----------------------------------------------------

    amp_obj$metadata <- amp_obj$metadata %>%
      mutate(
        basecalling = standardise_platform(
          basecalling
        ),
        sample_content = sample_label
      )

    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # Normalized long-format data
    # ----------------------------------------------------

    df_long <- amp_obj %>%
      amp_subset_samples(
        normalise = TRUE
      ) %>%
      amp_export_long() %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(
        basecalling = standardise_platform(
          basecalling
        ),
        sample_content = sample_label
      )

    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # Add the technical-replicate pairing ID
    # ----------------------------------------------------

    if (!pair_id %in% names(df_long)) {

      if (is.null(barcode_data)) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "`", pair_id,
            "` is not present in the metadata and ",
            "no `new_barcode` table was supplied."
          )
        )
      }

      if (
        !all(
          barcode_join_by %in%
            names(df_long)
        ) ||
          !all(
            barcode_join_by %in%
              names(barcode_data)
          )
      ) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "The join column(s) were not found in both ",
            "`df_long` and `new_barcode`: ",
            paste(
              barcode_join_by,
              collapse = ", "
            )
          )
        )
      }

      df_long <- df_long %>%
        left_join(
          barcode_data,
          by = barcode_join_by
        )
    }

    missing_pair_ids <- df_long %>%
      filter(
        is.na(.data[[pair_id]])
      ) %>%
      distinct(SampleID)

    if (nrow(missing_pair_ids) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          nrow(missing_pair_ids),
          " samples in ",
          sample_label,
          " could not be assigned a `",
          pair_id,
          "`. Check `barcode_join_by`."
        )
      )
    }

    # ====================================================
    # Heatmap data
    # ====================================================

    otu_rank_table <- df_long %>%
      group_by(OTU) %>%
      summarise(
        overall_mean_abundance = mean(
          count,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(
        desc(overall_mean_abundance),
        OTU
      ) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
      mutate(
        ASV_rank = row_number()
      )

    heatmap_data <- df_long %>%
      semi_join(
        otu_rank_table,
        by = "OTU"
      ) %>%
      group_by(
        OTU,
        basecalling
      ) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_abundance = mean(
          count,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        basecalling = as.character(
          basecalling
        )
      ) %>%
      complete(
        OTU,
        basecalling = c(
          "PacBio",
          "ONT"
        ),
        fill = list(
          mean_abundance = 0
        )
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        otu_rank_table %>%
          select(
            OTU,
            ASV_rank
          ),
        by = "OTU"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        basecalling = factor(
          basecalling,
          levels = c(
            "PacBio",
            "ONT"
          )
        ),
        sample_content = sample_label
      )

    # ====================================================
    # Pairwise Bray–Curtis distances
    # ====================================================

    abundance_wide <- df_long %>%
      group_by(
        SampleID,
        OTU
      ) %>%
      summarise(
        abundance = sum(count),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = OTU,
        values_from = abundance,
        values_fill = 0
      )

    abundance_matrix <- abundance_wide %>%
      column_to_rownames("SampleID") %>%
      as.matrix()

    # Remove samples containing no abundance
    abundance_matrix <- abundance_matrix[
      rowSums(abundance_matrix) > 0,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    sample_metadata <- df_long %>%
      transmute(
        SampleID,
        basecalling,
        pair_id = as.character(
          .data[[pair_id]]
        )
      ) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      filter(
        SampleID %in%
          rownames(abundance_matrix)
      )

    # Each SampleID must have one platform and one pair ID
    duplicated_metadata <- sample_metadata %>%
      count(SampleID) %>%
      filter(n > 1)

    if (nrow(duplicated_metadata) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Some SampleIDs in ",
          sample_label,
          " have multiple platform or pair-ID assignments."
        )
      )
    }

    if (nrow(abundance_matrix) < 2) {

      distance_data <- tibble(
        sample_1 = character(),
        sample_2 = character(),
        pair_id = character(),
        comparison_type = character(),
        point_group = character(),
        bray_curtis = double(),
        sample_content = character()
      )

    } else {

      bray_matrix <- abundance_matrix %>%
        vegan::vegdist(
          method = "bray"
        ) %>%
        as.matrix()

      sample_ids <- rownames(
        bray_matrix
      )

      sample_pairs <- combn(
        sample_ids,
        2,
        simplify = FALSE
      )

      distance_data <- map_dfr(
  sample_pairs,
  \(sample_pair) {

    sample_1 <- sample_pair[1]
    sample_2 <- sample_pair[2]

    metadata_1 <- sample_metadata %>%
      filter(SampleID == sample_1)

    metadata_2 <- sample_metadata %>%
      filter(SampleID == sample_2)

    if (
      nrow(metadata_1) != 1 ||
        nrow(metadata_2) != 1
    ) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    platform_1 <- as.character(
      metadata_1$basecalling
    )

    platform_2 <- as.character(
      metadata_2$basecalling
    )

    replicate_1 <- metadata_1$pair_id
    replicate_2 <- metadata_2$pair_id

    same_platform <- (
      platform_1 == platform_2
    )

    same_replicate <- (
      replicate_1 == replicate_2
    )

    # Retain:
    # 1. all comparisons among technical replicates
    #    within the same platform;
    # 2. matched replicates between PacBio and ONT.
    #
    # Exclude unmatched comparisons between platforms.
    if (
      !same_platform &&
        !same_replicate
    ) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    comparison_type <- if (
      same_platform
    ) {
      "Within platforms"
    } else {
      "Between platforms"
    }

    point_group <- if (
      same_platform
    ) {
      platform_1
    } else {
      "Between platforms"
    }

    tibble(
      sample_1 = sample_1,
      sample_2 = sample_2,

      replicate_1 = replicate_1,
      replicate_2 = replicate_2,

      pair_id = if (
        same_replicate
      ) {
        replicate_1
      } else {
        paste0(
          replicate_1,
          "–",
          replicate_2
        )
      },

      comparison_type = comparison_type,
      point_group = point_group,

      bray_curtis = bray_matrix[
        sample_1,
        sample_2
      ],

      sample_content = sample_label
    )
  }
)
      
      
      
      
      
      
    }

    list(
      heatmap_data = heatmap_data,
      distance_data = distance_data
    )
  }

  # ======================================================
  # Run each sample type independently
  # ======================================================

  individual_results <- imap(
    amp_objects,
    \(amp_obj, sample_label) {

      barcode_data <- if (
        is.list(new_barcode) &&
          !is.data.frame(new_barcode)
      ) {
        new_barcode[[sample_label]]
      } else {
        new_barcode
      }

      analyse_one(
        amp_obj = amp_obj,
        sample_label = sample_label,
        barcode_data = barcode_data
      )
    }
  )

  # ======================================================
  # Combined heatmap
  # ======================================================

  heatmap_data <- map_dfr(
    individual_results,
    "heatmap_data"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      sample_content = factor(
        sample_content,
        levels = sample_levels
      ),

      ASV_rank = factor(
        ASV_rank,
        levels = rev(
          seq_len(top_n)
        )
      ),

      fill_abundance = na_if(
        mean_abundance,
        0
      ),

      abundance_label = if_else(
        mean_abundance == 0,
        "–",
        sprintf(
          "%.2f",
          mean_abundance
        )
      )
    )

  bin_colors <- c(
    "#FFF5EB",
    "#F5C9B0",
    "#EC9E75",
    "#E2733B",
    "#D94801"
  )

  heatmap_plot <- ggplot(
    heatmap_data,
    aes(
      x = basecalling,
      y = ASV_rank,
      fill = fill_abundance
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile(
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = abundance_label),
      size = 3.2
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      cols = vars(sample_content),
      scales = "free_x",
      space = "free_x"
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = bin_colors,
      na.value = "grey90"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      expand = c(0, 0),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "ASV rank",
      fill = "Relative\nabundance (%)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
       strip.background = element_blank(),

  strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 13,
    face = "bold",
    color = "black",
    margin = margin(
      b = 7
    )
  ),
strip.text.y = element_text(
    size = 13,
    face = "bold",
    color = "black",
    margin = margin(
      b = 7
    )
  ),
# Keep only the left y-axis line
  axis.line.y.left = element_line(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ),

  # Add tick marks to the left y-axis
  axis.ticks.y.left = element_line(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ),
 axis.ticks.length.y.left = grid::unit(
    3,
    "pt"
  ),
  # Match axis styling
  axis.title.y = element_text(
    size = 12,
    face = "bold",
    color = "black",
    margin = margin(
      r = 8
    )
  ),

  axis.text.y = element_text(
    size = 10,
    color = "black"
  ),

  axis.text.x = element_text(
    size = 11,
    color = "black",
    margin = margin(
      t = 5
    )
  ),

  axis.ticks = element_line(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ),

  axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(
    2,
    "pt"
  ),

  panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(
    0.20,
    "cm"
  ),
axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(
  color = "black",
  linewidth = 0.4
),

axis.ticks.x.bottom = element_line(
  color = "black",
  linewidth = 0.5
),

axis.ticks.length.x.bottom = grid::unit(
  3,
  "pt"
),
  legend.position = "none",
    )

  # ======================================================
  # Combined Bray–Curtis data
  # ======================================================

  distance_data <- map_dfr(
    individual_results,
    "distance_data"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      sample_content = factor(
        sample_content,
        levels = sample_levels
      ),

      comparison_type = factor(
        comparison_type,
        levels = c(
          "Within platforms",
          "Between platforms"
        )
      ),

      point_group = factor(
        point_group,
        levels = c(
          "PacBio",
          "ONT",
          "Between platforms"
        )
      )
    )

  # Require at least two observations in both groups
  eligible_sample_types <- distance_data %>%
    count(
      sample_content,
      comparison_type
    ) %>%
    filter(n >= 2) %>%
    count(
      sample_content,
      name = "n_groups"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_groups == 2) %>%
    pull(sample_content)

  test_data <- distance_data %>%
    filter(
      sample_content %in%
        eligible_sample_types
    )

  # ======================================================
  # Welch tests within each sample type
  # ======================================================

  if (length(eligible_sample_types) > 0) {

    distance_tests <- test_data %>%
      group_by(sample_content) %>%
      t_test(
        bray_curtis ~ comparison_type,
        paired = FALSE,
        var.equal = FALSE
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      adjust_pvalue(
        method = p_adjust_method
      ) %>%
      add_significance("p.adj")

    y_positions <- distance_data %>%
      group_by(sample_content) %>%
      summarise(
        y.position =
          max(
            bray_curtis,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ) *
          1.12 +
          0.002,
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    distance_tests <- distance_tests %>%
      left_join(
        y_positions,
        by = "sample_content"
      )

  } else {

    distance_tests <- tibble()
  }

  # ======================================================
  # Bray–Curtis jitter plot
  # ======================================================

  point_colors <- c(
    "PacBio" =
      unname(
        seq_method_colors["PacBio"]
      ),

    "ONT" =
      unname(
        seq_method_colors["ONT"]
      ),

    "Between platforms" = "black"
  )

  distance_plot <- ggplot(
    distance_data %>% mutate(primer = primer_set),
    aes(
      x = comparison_type,
      y = bray_curtis,
      color = point_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.10,
      height = 0,
      size = 2.7,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      cols = vars(sample_content),
      rows = vars(primer),
      scales = "free_y"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = point_colors,
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = c(
        "Within platforms" =
          "Within\nplatforms",
        "Between platforms" =
          "Between\nplatforms"
      )
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA),
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(0.02, 0.20)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Bray–Curtis dissimilarity"
    ) +
    theme_marie_clean() +
    theme(
     # Match the facet headings
  strip.background = element_blank(),

  strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 13,
    face = "bold",
    color = "black",
    margin = margin(
      b = 7
    )
  ),
strip.text.y = element_text(
    size = 13,
    face = "bold",
    color = "black",
    margin = margin(
      b = 7
    )
  ),
  # Match axis styling
  axis.title.y = element_text(
    size = 12,
    face = "bold",
    color = "black",
    margin = margin(
      r = 8
    )
  ),

  axis.text.y = element_text(
    size = 10,
    color = "black"
  ),

  axis.text.x = element_text(
    size = 11,
    color = "black",
    margin = margin(
      t = 5
    )
  ),

  axis.ticks = element_line(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ),

  axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(
    2,
    "pt"
  ),

  panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(
    0.20,
    "cm"
  ),
axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(
  color = "black",
  linewidth = 0.4
),

axis.ticks.x.bottom = element_line(
  color = "black",
  linewidth = 0.5
),

axis.ticks.length.x.bottom = grid::unit(
  3,
  "pt"
),
  legend.position = "none",

  plot.margin = margin(
    5.5,
    5.5,
    5.5,
    5.5
  ),
    )

  if (nrow(distance_tests) > 0) {

    distance_plot <- distance_plot +
      stat_pvalue_manual(
        distance_tests,
        label = "p.adj.signif",
        hide.ns = hide_ns,
        tip.length = 0.01
      )
  }

  # ======================================================
  # Combined figure
  # ======================================================

  combined_plot <- heatmap_plot /
    distance_plot +
    plot_layout(
      heights = c(2.2, 1)
    )

  return(
    list(
      heatmap = heatmap_plot,
      distance_plot = distance_plot,
      distance_tests = distance_tests,
      distance_data = distance_data,
      combined = combined_plot,
      individual_results = individual_results
    )
  )
}
```

## Figure S16 - BC distance

```{r}



format_distance_row <- function(
  plot,
  show_column_headers = FALSE,
  show_x_axis = FALSE
) {

  plot +
    theme(
      strip.text.x = if (
        show_column_headers
      ) {
        element_text(
          size = 13,
          face = "bold",
          color = "black"
        )
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },
      
      axis.line.x.bottom = if (
          show_x_axis
        ) {
          element_line(
            color = "black",
            linewidth = 0.4
          )
        } else {
          element_blank()
        },
        
        axis.ticks.x.bottom = if (
          show_x_axis
        ) {
          element_line(
            color = "black",
            linewidth = 0.4
          )
        } else {
          element_blank()
        },
        
        axis.ticks.length.x.bottom = if (
          show_x_axis
        ) {
          grid::unit(3, "pt")
        } else {
          grid::unit(0, "pt")
        },

      axis.text.x = if (
        show_x_axis
      ) {
        element_text(
          size = 11,
          angle = 0,
          hjust = 0.5,
          lineheight = 0.9,
          color = "black",
          margin = margin(t = 5)
        )
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },

      axis.ticks.x = if (
        show_x_axis
      ) {
        element_line(
          color = "black",
          linewidth = 0.4
        )
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },

      axis.line.x = if (
        show_x_axis
      ) {
        element_line(
          color = "black",
          linewidth = 0.4
        )
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },
      

      axis.title.x = element_blank(),

      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(
        0.25,
        "cm"
      ),

      plot.margin = margin(
        3,
        5,
        3,
        5
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
combined_amp_long <- function(primer = "V1V8", rarefy_num = 228951){
# === 1. Load ampvis object ===
  amp_obj <- read_and_format_to_amp_object(
    base_dir = base_dir,
    base_dir2 =  paste0(WD, "/results/"),
    primerset_name = {{primer}}, #"V1V8",
    subsample_group = "all_reads",
    global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match = global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match,
    new_barcode = new_barcode,
    type = "_all"
  )

  amp_obj <- amp_obj %>% amp_subset_samples(rarefy = {{rarefy_num}})

  # === 2. Fix metadata ===
  amp_obj$metadata <- amp_obj$metadata %>%
    mutate(
      type = sub(".*_", "", SampleID),
      abun_tab = case_when(
        type == "all" ~ "-otutab",
        type == "exact" ~ "-search_exact"
      ),
      basecalling = factor(basecalling,
                           levels = c("pacbio", "super"),
                           labels = c("PacBio", "ONT"))
    )

# === 4. LONG DATA ===
  df_long <- amp_obj %>%
    amp_subset_samples(normalise = TRUE) %>%
    amp_export_long()
  
}


df_long_comp <- 
  rbind(
    amp_V4_merge  %>% amp_subset_samples(normalise = T) %>% amp_export_long(),
    amp_V1V3_merge %>% amp_subset_samples(normalise = T)  %>% amp_export_long(),
    amp_V1V8_merge %>% amp_subset_samples(normalise = T)  %>% amp_export_long(),
    amp_OPR_merge %>% amp_subset_samples(normalise = T) %>% amp_export_long()
    ) %>% 
  filter(!OTU %in% unlist(lenght_df$global_asv_id))

# %>% 
#   mutate(is_ref = OTU %in%
#              (global_ASVs_zymo_all_ref_match %>%
#                 filter(Match_type == "Exact") %>%
#                 pull(global_asv_id)))

  # === 5. Compute OTU rank table ===
  otu_rank_table_PB <- df_long_comp %>%
    filter(basecalling == "PacBio") %>% 
    group_by(OTU, primerset, ,sample_content, new_barcode) %>%
    summarise(mean_abun_PB = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abun_PB), OTU) %>%
    mutate(ASV_rank_PB = row_number())

  
  otu_rank_table_ONT <- df_long_comp %>%
    filter(basecalling == "ONT") %>% 
    group_by(OTU, primerset, new_barcode, sample_content) %>%
    summarise(mean_abun_ONT = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abun_ONT), OTU) %>%
    mutate(ASV_rank_ONT = row_number())
  
#asv_mean_abundance <- full_join(otu_rank_table_ONT, otu_rank_table_PB) 

# Individual PCR-replicate observations
replicate_abundance <- full_join(
  otu_rank_table_ONT,
  otu_rank_table_PB,
  # by = c("OTU", "primerset", "new_barcode", "sample_content" #, "is_ref"
  #        )
) %>% 
  mutate(
    #mean_abun_ONT = replace_na(mean_abun_ONT, 0),
    #mean_abun_PB  = replace_na(mean_abun_PB, 0),
    # is_ref = factor(
    #   is_ref,
    #   levels = c(TRUE, FALSE),
    #   labels = c("Reference ASV", "Non-reference ASV")
    # )
  ) %>% 
  left_join(detected_by %>% rename("OTU" = "global_asv_id")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(basecalling)) 

# Mean across the four PCR replicates
asv_mean_abundance <- replicate_abundance %>%
  group_by(primerset, OTU, sample_content, detected_by) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abun_ONT = mean(mean_abun_ONT, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abun_PB  = mean(mean_abun_PB, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    ten_reads = case_when(
      primerset == "V4" ~ 100/5126*5, 
      primerset == "V1V3" ~ 100/29083*5, 
      primerset == "V1V8" ~ 100/88500*5, 
      primerset == "OPR" ~ 100/27135*5, .default = NA
      ),
     primerset = factor(primerset, levels = c("V4", "V1V3", "V1V8", "OPR"),
                            labels = c("V4 (5126 reads)", "V1-V3 (29083 reads)", "V1-V8 (88500 reads)", "OPR (27135 reads)")), 
    sample_content = factor(sample_content, levels =c("Zmock", "Zfecal", "AD", "WWTP", "Soil"), 
                            labels =c("Zmock", "Fecal", "AD", "WWTP", "Soil")), 
    detected_by = factor(detected_by, levels = c("ONT and PacBio","ONT", "PacBio"))
    
    )
# %>% 
#   left_join(detected_by %>% rename("OTU" = "global_asv_id") %>% select())

correlation_results <- asv_mean_abundance %>%
  group_by(primerset, sample_content) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    test <- cor.test(
      .x$mean_abun_ONT,
      .x$mean_abun_PB,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )

    tibble(
      rho = unname(test$estimate),
      p_value = test$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "\u03c1 = ", sprintf("%.3f", rho),
      "\n P", format.pval(
        p_value,
        digits = 2,
        eps = 0.001,
        prefix = "P "
      )
    )
  )

  ),

) +
scale_y_continuous(
  trans = pseudo_log,
  limits = c(0, NA),
  breaks = axis_breaks,
  labels = function(x) format(
    x,
    scientific = FALSE,
    trim = TRUE
  ),

)

# Correlation between ASV relative abundances obtained using ONT and PacBio sequencing. Small translucent points represent individual technical PCR replicates, whereas larger points represent the mean relative abundance across the four replicates. Colours distinguish ASVs with and without an exact match to the reference sequences. The dashed line represents equal relative abundance between sequencing platforms. Spearman correlations were calculated from the replicate-averaged ASV abundances separately for each primer set.
```

## Figure 6B

```{r}
amp_merge_full_1 <- amp_merge_ampvis2(amp_V1V3_merge, amp_V4_merge, by_refseq = FALSE)

amp_merge_full_2 <- amp_merge_ampvis2(amp_merge_full_1, amp_V1V8_merge, by_refseq = FALSE) %>% 
  amp_subset_samples(rarefy = 5126, normalise = T)


amp_merge_full_long <- amp_merge_full_2 %>% 
  amp_export_long() %>% as_tibble() %>% 
  group_by(SampleID) %>% 
  mutate(mapped_reads = sum(count)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(SampleID, OTU) %>% 
  mutate(rel_abun_ASV = sum(count)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(SampleID, Species) %>% 
  mutate(rel_abun_species = sum(rel_abun_ASV)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(SampleID, Family) %>% 
  mutate(rel_abun_family = sum(rel_abun_ASV)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(SampleID, Genus) %>% 
  mutate(rel_abun_genus = sum(rel_abun_ASV)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  nest(samples = c(OTU, mapped_reads, count, Genus, Species, Family,
                   rel_abun_ASV, rel_abun_species, rel_abun_genus, rel_abun_family))
```

```{r}


# === 5. Compute OTU rank table ===
  otu_rank_table <- amp_merge_full_long %>%
  unnest(samples) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Family, "unclass")) %>% 
  group_by(Family, sample_content#, basecalling, primerset
           ) %>%
  summarise(mean_abun = mean(rel_abun_family, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abun), Family) %>%
    group_by(sample_content#, basecalling, primerset
             ) %>% 
    #mutate(ASV_rank = row_number()) %>% 
    #slice_min(ASV_rank, n = 10) %>% 
  slice_max(mean_abun, n = 15) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(sample_content, desc(mean_abun)) %>%
  distinct(sample_content, Family) %>% 
  #arrange(sample_content) %>% 
  mutate(ASV_rank = row_number()) %>% ungroup()

#%>% 
#  select(-basecalling, -primerset) 
# %>% 
#   pivot_wider(names_from = basecalling, values_from = mean_abun)

  # === 6. Heatmap ===
  bin_colors <- c("#FFF5EB", "#F5C9B0", "#EC9E75", "#E2733B", "#D94801")
  #hm_title <- df_long %>% distinct(sample_content) %>% unlist()

  hm <- amp_merge_full_long %>%
    unnest(samples) %>% 
    inner_join(otu_rank_table#, by = "Family"

    group_by(Family, basecalling, #ASV_rank, 
             sample_content, primerset) %>%
    summarise(mean_abun_2 = mean(rel_abun_family), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      #OTU_clean = paste0("ASV", ASV_rank),
      OTU_label = paste0(sample_content, Family),
      mean_abun_2 = if_else(mean_abun_2 == 0, NA, mean_abun_2),
      primerset = factor(primerset, levels = c("V4", "V1V3", "V1V8", "OPR"), labels = c("V4", "V1-V3", "V1-V8", "OPR")), 
    sample_content = factor(sample_content, levels =c("Zmock", "Zfecal", "AD", "WWTP", "Soil")), 
    ) %>%
    arrange((mean_abun_2)) %>% 
      #ASV_rank)) %>% 
    mutate(OTU_label = fct_inorder(OTU_label)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = basecalling, y = OTU_label, fill = mean_abun_2)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = if_else(mean_abun_2 == 0, "-", sprintf("%.1f", mean_abun_2))), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = bin_colors, na.value = "grey90") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Relative\nabundance (%)") +
    facet_nested(sample_content~primerset, space = "free", scales = "free", switch = "y") +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), 
                     labels = function(x) str_replace(x, "^.*?__", "")) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    #theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme_marie_clean() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, , color = "black", angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none", strip.placement = "outside", 
      strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 1, hjust = 0, size = 16, face = "bold"), 
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), 
    )
```

### Genus Heatmap 

```{r}


# === 5. Compute OTU rank table ===
  otu_rank_table <- amp_merge_full_long %>%
  unnest(samples) %>% 
    filter(!str_detect(Genus, "unclass")) %>% 
  group_by(Genus, sample_content#, basecalling, primerset
           ) %>%
  summarise(mean_abun = mean(rel_abun_genus, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abun), Genus) %>%
    group_by(sample_content, 
             #basecalling, primerset
             ) %>% 
    #mutate(ASV_rank = row_number()) %>% 
    #slice_min(ASV_rank, n = 10) %>% 
  slice_max(mean_abun, n = 15) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  #select(-basecalling, -primerset) %>% 
  arrange(sample_content, desc(mean_abun)) %>%
  distinct(sample_content, Genus) %>% 
  #arrange(sample_content) %>% 
  mutate(ASV_rank = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
# %>% 
#   pivot_wider(names_from = basecalling, values_from = mean_abun)

  # === 6. Heatmap ===
  bin_colors <- c("#FFF5EB", "#F5C9B0", "#EC9E75", "#E2733B", "#D94801")
  #hm_title <- df_long %>% distinct(sample_content) %>% unlist()

  hm_genus <- amp_merge_full_long %>%
    unnest(samples) %>% 
    inner_join(otu_rank_table#, by = "Family"
               ) %>%
    group_by(Genus, basecalling, ASV_rank, 
             sample_content, primerset) %>%
    summarise(mean_abun_2 = mean(rel_abun_genus), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      #OTU_clean = paste0("ASV", ASV_rank),
      OTU_label = paste0(sample_content, Genus),
      mean_abun_2 = if_else(mean_abun_2 == 0, NA, mean_abun_2),
      primerset = factor(primerset, levels = c("V4", "V1V3", "V1V8", "OPR")), 
    sample_content = factor(sample_content, levels =c("Zmock", "Zfecal", "AD", "WWTP", "Soil")), 
    ) %>% ungroup() %>% 
    arrange(sample_content, desc(ASV_rank)) %>% 
    #mutate(OTU_label = fct_inorder(OTU_label)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(OTU_label = fct_inorder(OTU_label)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = basecalling, y = OTU_label, fill = mean_abun_2)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = if_else(mean_abun_2 == 0, "-", sprintf("%.1f", mean_abun_2))), size = 3.5) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = bin_colors, na.value = "grey90") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Relative\nabundance (%)") +
    facet_nested(sample_content~primerset, space = "free", scales = "free", switch = "y") +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), 
                     labels = function(x) str_replace(x, "^.*?__", "")) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    #theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme_marie_clean() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, , color = "black", angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none", strip.placement = "outside", 
      strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 1, hjust = 0, size = 16, face = "bold"), 
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), 
    )

hm_genus
```

```{r}
# === 5. Compute OTU rank table ===
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
file_data <- vroom::vroom("/home/bio.aau.dk/hd95lp/Projects/RETHINK/p_nanopore_amplicon/1_data/primer_test/SRA_upload_all_fastq/SRA_metadata.txt")

metadata_ncbi <- 
  file_data %>%
  left_join(new_barcode) %>%  
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    library_ID = paste0(sequencing_platform , "_", primerset, "_", sample_content, "_", barcode, "_rep_", new_barcode), 
    sample_name = paste0(sequencing_platform , "_", primerset, "_", sample_content, "_", barcode),
    title = "Improved Nanopore sequencing accuracy enables ASV-resolved microbial profiling", 
    library_strategy = "AMPLICON",
    library_source = case_when(
      sample_content %in% c("AD", "Soil", "WWTP") ~ "METAGENOMIC", 
      sample_content %in% c("Zfecal", "Zmock") ~ "SYNTHETIC", 
    ), 
    library_selection = "PCR", 
    library_layout = "single", 
    platform = case_when(
      sequencing_platform == "PacBio" ~ "PACBIO_SMRT", 
      sequencing_platform == "ONT" ~ "OXFORD_NANOPORE",
    ), 
    instrument_model = case_when(
      sequencing_platform == "PacBio" ~ "Revio", 
      sequencing_platform == "ONT" ~ "PromethION",
    ), 
    design_description = case_when(
      primerset == "V4" ~ "V4 primers used had the following sequences: 5’GTGYCAGCMGCCGCGGTAA 3’ and 5’GGACTACNVGGGTWTCTAAT 3’ (515f;806r)", 
      primerset == "V1V3" ~ "V1-V3 primers used had the following sequences: 5’ AGAGTTTGATCCTGGCTCAG 3’ and 5’ ATTACCGCGGCTGCTGG 3’ (27f;534r)",
      primerset == "V1V8" ~ "V1-V8 primers used had the following sequences: 5’ AGRGTTYGATYMTGGCTCAG 3’ and 5’ GACGGGCGGTGWGTRCA (27f;1391r)", 
      primerset == "OPR" ~ "OPR primers used had the following sequences: 5’ AGRGTTYGATYMTGGCTCAG 3’ and 5’ CGACATCGAGGTGCCAAAC (16S-8f;23S-2490r)",
    ),
    filetype = "fastq",
    ) 



  
metadata_ncbi_final <- metadata_ncbi %>% 
  select(sample_name, library_ID, title, library_strategy,library_source,	library_selection,
         library_layout,	platform,	instrument_model,	design_description,	filetype, filename)

# Create sample_names()# Create a new workbook

# Add a worksheet to the workbook
addWorksheet(my_wb, "Sheet1")
# Write the data to the worksheet
writeData(my_wb, "Sheet1", metadata_ncbi_final)
# Save the workbook to a file
saveWorkbook(my_wb, paste0("/home/bio.aau.dk/hd95lp/Projects/RETHINK/p_nanopore_amplicon/1_data/primer_test/SRA_upload_all_fastq/20250425_metadata_SRA.xlsx"))
```
